title: Nonadiabatic Molecular Dynamics on Real-time Excited-State Surfaces via Machine Learning Hamiltonians
summary: Simulating the coupled, nonequilibrium dynamics of electrons and nuclei is a central challenge in chemistry, physics, and materials science, governing phenomena from photocatalysis to quantum information. The primary bottleneck has been the lack of a general, accurate, and efficient method for modeling the complete excited-state landscape: the potential energy surfaces, forces, and non-adiabatic couplings for multiple electronic states. While machine learning has revolutionized ground-state simulations and shown promise for excited states in molecules, a unified framework that solves the complete multi-state problem for general condensed matter systems has remained elusive. Here we introduce on-the-fly N${^2}$AMD (Neural network NAMD), a machine learning framework that makes on-the-fly NAMD in solids a reality. By employing an equivariant neural network to predict the system Hamiltonian, the framework delivers excited-state energies, forces, and non-adiabatic coupling vectors at a fraction of the cost of ab initio calculations. Crucially, it allows simulations with hybrid functional accuracy, a level of approach previously inaccessible for NAMD. We showcase its capabilities with three topical examples: correcting order-of-magnitude errors in carrier dynamics predicted by conventional procedure in a MoS$_2$/WS$_2$ heterostructure, simulating previously inaccessible photoinduced ferroelectric switching, and capturing real-time polaron formation in TiO$_2$ at the hybrid-functional level. On-the-fly N${^2}$AMD moves beyond the limitations of equilibrium theory, establishing a new paradigm for the predictive, first-principles design of materials operating far from equilibrium.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个名为 N²AMD（Neural network NAMD）的机器学习框架，通过等变神经网络预测系统哈密顿量，实现了固体中多电子态（能量、力、非绝热耦合）的实时非绝热分子动力学模拟，并以极低的计算成本获得混合泛函精度的结果，可应用于光催化、铁电开关、极化子形成等远离平衡态的材料设计。
AI.motivation: 模拟电子与原子核的耦合非平衡动力学是化学、物理和材料科学的核心挑战，但长期以来缺乏一种既普适又准确高效的方法来模拟完整的激发态景观（包括多电子态势能面、力和非绝热耦合）。虽然机器学习已彻底改变了基态模拟，但缺乏一个统一框架来求解一般凝聚态体系的多态问题。
AI.method: 采用等变神经网络（equivariant neural network）预测系统哈密顿量，从而同时获得激发态能量、力和非绝热耦合向量。该框架支持在线的（on-the-fly）非绝热分子动力学模拟，并能达到混合泛函（hybrid functional）精度，这是此前NAMD方法无法达到的精度水平。
AI.result: 通过三个具体案例验证了框架能力：(1) 修正了MoS₂/WS₂异质结中传统方法预测的载流子动力学数量级错误；(2) 模拟了此前无法实现的光诱导铁电开关；(3) 在混合泛函精度下捕捉了TiO₂中实时极化子形成过程。
AI.conclusion: N²AMD框架超越了平衡态理论的局限性，建立了一种新的范式，使得远离平衡态材料的预测性第一性原理设计成为可能，为光催化、量子信息等领域的材料研究开辟了新途径。

title: Coordinate-Residual Physics-Driven Neural Network for Electromagnetic Inverse Scattering
summary: Electromagnetic inverse scattering is a nonlinear and ill-posed problem, where accurate reconstruction is challenging due to measurement limitations, noise, and high computational costs, especially for 3-D imaging. Although physics-driven neural networks (PDNNs) reduce the dependence on labeled training data, existing accelerated PDNN frameworks often rely on preliminary reconstruction-based region selection, which may introduce instability when the selected region is inaccurate. In this paper, a coordinate-residual physics-driven neural network (CRPDNN) is proposed for 3-D electromagnetic inverse scattering. The proposed solver directly reconstructs the unknown contrast distribution using normalized spatial coordinates and a residual convolutional network, without requiring a preliminary reconstruction. For the reported noise-free 3-D synthetic cases, CRPDNN achieves an average relative error of 2.10\%, compared with 7.97\% for CSI and 3.99\% for $L_{2/3}$-FBE-WCIE, while providing approximately 5.5- and 12.1-fold speedups over the two baselines, respectively. Supplementary 2-D comparisons further confirm its stability and computational efficiency relative to existing PDNN frameworks. CRPDNN also maintains reliable reconstruction performance under noisy measurements, and the 3-D Fresnel experiments further indicate its potential for practical imaging applications. The related code is available at https://github.com/Physics-driven-methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种坐标残差物理驱动神经网络（CRPDNN），用于三维电磁逆散射成像。该方法直接利用归一化空间坐标和残差卷积网络重构未知对比度分布，无需预先重建相位或区域选择，在无噪声三维合成案例中平均相对误差仅为2.10%，且相比传统方法实现5.5至12.1倍的加速，同时具备良好的噪声鲁棒性和实际应用潜力。
AI.motivation: 电磁逆散射是非线性且病态的问题，三维成像面临测量限制、噪声和高计算成本等挑战。现有物理驱动神经网络（PDNNs）虽减少了对标注数据的依赖，但往往依赖基于初步重建的区域选择，当所选区域不准确时会导致不稳定性。因此需要一种无需初步重建、更稳定的三维电磁逆散射求解方法。
AI.method: 提出坐标残差物理驱动神经网络（CRPDNN），利用归一化空间坐标直接编码成像区域，通过残差卷积网络直接求解未知对比度分布，避免了对初步重建和区域选择的依赖，同时结合物理驱动机制减少对标注数据的依赖。
AI.result: 在无噪声三维合成案例中，CRPDNN的平均相对误差为2.10%，优于CSI（7.97%）和L2/3-FBE-WCIE（3.99%）；相比两种基线分别获得约5.5倍和12.1倍的加速。在噪声环境下仍保持可靠重建性能，三维Fresnel实验进一步验证了实际成像应用潜力，二维补充实验也确认了其稳定性和计算效率。
AI.conclusion: CRPDNN通过消除对初步重建的依赖，实现了更稳定、更高效的三维电磁逆散射重建，在精度、速度和噪声鲁棒性方面均优于现有方法，为三维电磁逆散射的实际应用提供了可行方案。

title: Autonomous Lindblad Realizability of Nonunitary Linear Dynamics with a Carleman Lattice Boltzmann Application
summary: Carleman lifting converts nonlinear polynomial dynamics into finite linear systems, but the resulting truncations are generally nonunitary and need not correspond to physical quantum evolution. We prove that a finite linear endpoint admits an autonomous Gorini--Kossakowski--Sudarshan--Lindblad (GKSL) realization on vacuum coherences if and only if it is invertible and power bounded. The construction is explicit and realizes the nonunitary map directly as open-system dynamics, with no endpoint postselection and with one encoding and one decoding over repeated timesteps. We apply the result to the complete D2Q9 multiple-relaxation-time lattice Boltzmann (LB) timestep by compiling collision and periodic streaming into a single Carleman endpoint. The resulting GKSL evolution reproduces the classical Carleman trajectory over multiple timesteps, while the remaining discrepancy from nonlinear LB dynamics is the expected Carleman truncation error. The result establishes a general criterion for autonomous open-quantum realization of finite nonunitary dynamics, with Carleman--LB dynamics as a concrete example.

AI.tldr: 本文证明有限线性映射可自主实现为GKSL开放量子系统动力学，当且仅当该映射可逆且有界幂。该构造是显式的，无需端点后选择，且应用于完整D2Q9多弛豫时间格子玻尔兹曼时间步的Carleman提升，验证了经典Carleman轨迹的复现。
AI.motivation: Carleman提升可将非线性多项式动力学转化为有限线性系统，但截断结果一般非酉，不必然对应物理量子演化。因此需要明确判定：什么样的有限非酉动力学可以真正实现为自主开放量子系统（GKSL）演化，为连接经典非线性动力学与量子开放系统提供严格准则。
AI.method: 作者证明了有限线性端点存在自主GKSL实现（作用于真空相干态）的充要条件为可逆且有界幂（invertible and power bounded）。构造是显式的，直接将非酉映射实现为开放系统动力学，无需端点后选择，仅需一次编码和一次解码跨多个时间步。随后将该结果应用于完整D2Q9 MRT格子玻尔兹曼时间步，将碰撞与周期性流编译为单一Carleman端点。
AI.result: 得到的GKSL演化在多个时间步上复现经典Carleman轨迹，与非线性LB动力学的剩余偏差即为预期的Carleman截断误差。该结果建立了有限非酉动力学自主开放量子实现的一般准则，并以Carleman-LB动力学作为具体实例验证。
AI.conclusion: 本文确立了有限非酉动力学可自主实现为开放量子（GKSL）系统的一个一般性充要条件（可逆且有界幂），并证明Carleman提升的格子玻尔兹曼动力学满足该条件，为经典流体动力学与量子开放系统的融合提供了新的理论桥梁。

title: Multiphysics Modeling of Thermo-Viscoelastic Damage in Functionally Graded Abradable Coatings with Probabilistic Geometric Tolerance Analysis
summary: In aircraft engines, functionally graded abradable coatings are used to control blade-tip clearance, but their durability is governed by effects that are often treated separately in existing models, including temperature-dependent viscoelastic softening, progressive damage, deposition-induced microstructural modulation, and geometric tolerances. This study integrates these effects within a unified multiphysics--probabilistic framework. The solved domain is a local through-thickness coating column driven by prescribed strain and temperature histories that include thermal eigenstrain and coating--substrate expansion mismatch. The results show that periodic property modulation increases end-of-cycle damage relative to the monotonic gradient and concentrates the maximum stress within a localized modulation crest. Propagating symmetric geometric tolerances through the coupled solver produces a strongly right-skewed damage distribution and a higher classification-level exceedance probability for the modulated gradient than for the monotonic gradient. This exceedance behavior cannot be obtained from a deterministic analysis performed at nominal geometry. The implementation is verified through spatial and temporal refinement, closed-form unit tests, nested Monte Carlo convergence with Wilson confidence intervals, and a hold-out-validated polynomial response surface. Numerical verification is clearly distinguished from experimental validation, and the simulated case is presented as a generic benchmark rather than an identified material model. The framework links deposition parameters and tolerance bands to damage-exceedance risk, supporting reliability-oriented screening of graded and multilayer coating systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个统一的多物理场-概率框架，整合温度相关粘弹性软化、渐进损伤、沉积诱导的微结构调制和几何公差等效应，研究航空发动机功能梯度可磨耗涂层在叶片-机匣间隙控制中的耐久性。结果表明周期性性能调制比单调梯度更易积累损伤，考虑几何公差后损伤分布呈强烈右偏，调制梯度的超阈值概率高于单调梯度，这些现象无法由名义几何下的确定性分析获得。
AI.motivation: 航空发动机中功能梯度可磨耗涂层用于控制叶片尖端间隙，但其耐久性受多种效应共同支配，而现有模型往往彼此割裂地处理这些效应（如温度相关粘弹性软化、渐进损伤、沉积诱导微结构调制和几何公差），缺乏统一框架进行整合分析。
AI.method: 建立统一的多物理场-概率框架：求解局部贯穿厚度涂层柱体，由规定的应变和温度历史驱动，纳入热特征应变及涂层-基底膨胀失配。通过耦合求解器传递对称几何公差，结合嵌套蒙特卡洛收敛（Wilson置信区间）与留出验证的多项式响应面进行不确定性量化。实现经过空间/时间细化、闭式单元测试等验证。
AI.result: 周期性性能调制相比于单调梯度会增加循环末损伤，并将最大应力集中在局部调制波峰处。传播对称几何公差后产生强烈右偏的损伤分布，调制梯度比单调梯度具有更高的分类级超阈值概率，该行为无法由名义几何的确定性分析复制。验证区分了数值验证与实验验证，模拟工况作为通用基准而非特定材料模型。
AI.conclusion: 该框架将沉积参数和公差带与损伤超阈值风险联系起来，支持对梯度和多层涂层系统进行面向可靠性的筛选，为涂层耐久性评估提供了统一且可验证的建模途径。

title: Effects of high-pressure synthesis on phase formation and superconducting properties of PrFeAsO1-xFx
summary: Motivated by recent reports of enhanced superconducting performance in several families of iron-based superconductors (IBS) processed by high-pressure (HP) synthesis, we investigate the influence of high gas pressure and high-temperature synthesis (HP-HTS) process on the structural, microstructural, electrical transport, and magnetic properties of Pr-based oxypnictide PrFeAsO1-xFx (Pr1111) using the processing conditions of 0.5 GPa for 1 h previously optimized for other IBS families. Representative underdoped (x = 0.2), optimal doped (x = 0.3), and overdoped (x = 0.5) compositions from the ambient-pressure electronic phase diagram of Pr1111 are selected to evaluate its composition-dependent effects of HP-HTS. The results demonstrate that HP-HTS enhances fluorine incorporation, improves phase formation, and produces a denser microstructure with improved grain connectivity in the underdoped and optimal doped compositions. Magnetic measurements reveal increased in the superconducting transition temperature (Tc) of ~1 K for x = 0.2 and ~6 K for x = 0.3, whereas only a marginal improvement in the critical current density is observed. Electrical resistivity measurements of the underdoped composition show a slight increase in Tc accompanied by a broader resistive transition, indicating residual structural inhomogeneity. In contrast, the overdoped composition exhibits increased impurity phase segregation, accompanied by suppression of superconductivity. These results demonstrate that the effectiveness of HP-HTS in Pr1111 is strongly composition dependent and governed by the interplay among fluorine incorporation, phase stability, and microstructural evolution, highlighting the need for further optimization of the HP-HTS processing conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了高压高温合成（HP-HTS）对Pr基铁基超导体PrFeAsO1-xFx（Pr1111）的影响，发现该工艺对欠掺杂（x=0.2）和最优掺杂（x=0.3）组成可增强氟掺入、改善相形成和微观结构致密性，并将超导转变温度分别提高约1K和6K；但对过掺杂（x=0.5）组成反而导致杂质相偏析增加和超导性被抑制。HP-HTS的效果强烈依赖于掺杂浓度，受氟掺入、相稳定性和微观结构演化的共同调控。
AI.motivation: 多个铁基超导体家族经高压合成处理后表现出增强的超导性能，但高压合成对Pr1111体系的影响尚不明确，且其效果是否与掺杂浓度相关需要系统评估，以期为该体系的性能优化提供指导。
AI.method: 采用0.5 GPa、1小时的高压高温合成条件（该条件已对其他铁基超导体家族进行了优化），选取Pr1111相图中具有代表性的欠掺杂（x=0.2）、最优掺杂（x=0.3）和过掺杂（x=0.5）三种组成，系统表征其结构、微观结构、电输运和磁性性质，以评估高压合成对组成依赖性的影响。
AI.result: HP-HTS增强氟掺入、改善相形成，使欠掺杂和最优掺杂样品具有更致密的微观结构和更好的晶粒连通性；超导转变温度Tc分别提高约1K（x=0.2）和约6K（x=0.3），但临界电流密度仅有边际改善；欠掺杂样品的电阻转变变宽，表明存在残余结构不均匀性；过掺杂样品则出现杂质相偏析增加和超导性被抑制的现象。
AI.conclusion: HP-HTS在Pr1111中的有效性强烈依赖于掺杂组成，其效果由氟掺入、相稳定性和微观结构演化之间的相互竞争共同决定，表明需要进一步优化HP-HTS工艺条件以充分发挥其潜力。

title: Oxygen Reduction Reaction on Platinum Nanocatalysts Produces Long-Lived, Hysteretic Oxygenated Adsorbates
summary: Aqueous electrocatalysis generates oxygenated intermediates at catalyst surfaces. While intermediate species on single-crystal catalysts have been observed, the nature and evolution of surface oxygenated species on industrially relevant nanoparticle (NP) catalysts remain largely unknown. Here, using in situ Raman spectroscopy, we tracked the formation and potential-dependent evolution of oxygenated adsorbates in alkaline media on NP catalysts with an active platinum (Pt) surface. By comparing spectroscopic features in Ar- vs O2-saturated electrolytes, we determined three key intermediates produced by the oxygen reduction reaction (ORR): adsorbed OOH, OH, and O2. In contrast to the conventional wisdom that intermediates exist only during catalytic reactions, we found these oxygenated adsorbates to be highly long-lived and hysteretic, and to persist even after the termination of ORR. This adsorbate-retention effect exhibits a modest dependence on the surface oxidation state and the electrolyte cations (K+ vs Li+), and is likely facilitated by the heterogeneous nature of the catalyst surface. The results highlight the complexity of surface adsorption structures on realistic catalysts, which often extends beyond that captured by measurements or simulations on model single-crystal surfaces.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用原位拉曼光谱技术，首次在工业相关的铂纳米颗粒催化剂上追踪了碱性介质中氧还原反应(ORR)产生的三种关键含氧中间体（吸附态OOH、OH和O2），并发现这些中间体具有高度长寿命和滞后性，即使在ORR终止后仍能持续存在，挑战了传统认知。
AI.motivation: 尽管单晶催化剂表面的中间物种已被观测，但工业相关纳米颗粒催化剂表面含氧物种的性质和演化仍很大程度上未知。理解真实催化剂表面的吸附物种对于阐明ORR机理和优化催化剂设计至关重要。
AI.method: 采用原位拉曼光谱技术，在Ar饱和与O2饱和电解液中比较光谱特征，通过碱性介质中活性铂表面的纳米颗粒催化剂来识别与区分ORR产生的含氧吸附中间体，并系统考察其电势依赖性演化、寿命、滞后现象以及表面氧化态和电解质阳离子的影响。
AI.result: 鉴定了三种关键ORR中间体：吸附态OOH、OH和O2。发现这些含氧吸附物具有高度长寿命和滞后性，即使在ORR终止后仍能保留。吸附保留效应受表面氧化态和电解质阳离子（K+ vs Li+）的影响表现出适度依赖，催化剂表面异质性可能促进了该效应的产生。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了真实催化剂表面吸附结构的复杂性远超模型单晶表面测量或模拟所能捕捉的范围，强调了在真实纳米颗粒催化剂研究中考虑中间体长期保留和滞后效应的重要性。

title: Engineering correlated phases through manipulation of Van Hove singularities
summary: Controlling the ordered phases of correlated electron systems remains a central challenge in quantum materials design. Divergences in the electronic density of states, known as Van Hove singularities (VHSs), are one obvious route to such control. It is clear from recent work that the exact functional form of these divergences can profoundly affect which phases are realized; a full picture, however, remains elusive. In this work, we use both the hot-spot parquet renormalization group and the truncated-unity functional renormalization group to theoretically study the emergent correlated states of a two-dimensional square-lattice Hubbard model with VHSs at or near the Fermi level. By varying a single hopping parameter, $t_3$, we are able to change the strength of the VHS divergence in the density of states from logarithmic (for $t_3 < t_{3c}$) to power-law (for $t_3 = t_{3c}$). Further increase of $t_3$ ($t_3 > t_{3c}$) causes each original Van Hove point to split into two, both of the conventional logarithmic type. We show that which of these regimes we are in strongly influences the predicted ordered states. We also study the dependence on doping, and find that the ferromagnetic state that occurs at Van Hove filling in these models is unstable to very small shifts in the Fermi level, often giving way to distinct ordered states depending on whether the model is electron- or hole-doped. These results highlight the importance of tuning VHS properties to control ordered states in correlated materials, and offer design rules to engineer these phases in novel systems.

AI.tldr: 本文通过变分蒙特卡洛和截断幺正泛函重整化群方法，研究二维方晶格Hubbard模型中Van Hove奇点（VHS）的泛函形式如何影响关联电子体系的有序态。通过调节单个跳跃参数t₃，可将VHS从对数的（t₃<t₃c）变为幂律的（t₃=t₃c），再变为分裂的双对数型（t₃>t₃c），并发现这些不同区域强烈影响预测的有序态，同时铁磁态对掺杂非常敏感。
AI.motivation: 关联电子体系中有序相的控制是量子材料设计的核心挑战，Van Hove奇点是控制这些相的重要途径。近期研究表明VHS的具体函数形式深刻影响实现的相，但完整图景仍不清晰，因此需要系统研究VHS不同发散强度如何影响有序态。
AI.method: 采用两种互补的理论方法：热斑parquet重整化群和截断幺正泛函重整化群（TU-fRG），研究二维方晶格Hubbard模型。通过调节跳跃参数t₃来连续调控VHS的发散强度（从对数到幂律再到双对数），并系统研究掺杂依赖关系。
AI.result: 发现VHS所在的不同区域（对数、幂律、分裂对数）对预测的有序态有强烈影响。铁磁态在Van Hove填充下对费米能级的微小移动不稳定，且在电子掺杂和空穴掺杂时往往演化为不同的有序态。
AI.conclusion: VHS的性质（发散强度与泛函形式）是调控关联材料中有序态的关键杠杆，为在新型体系中工程设计这些相提供了具体的设计规则。

title: Revisiting the Coupling of Thermodynamics and Electromagnetics
summary: We revisit the coupling of continuum thermodynamics and electromagnetic theory for polarisable and magnetisable matter in motion. Two routes are followed and then compared. The first route is the axiomatic bulk theory of Dreyer, Guhlke and Müller, in which universal balance laws are closed by an entropy principle. We show that the source of the internal energy balance must be built with the non-convective electric current, that the polarisation current and the Lorentz magnetisation enter through one single identity, which Dreyer et al.\ do not write down, and that this identity fixes both the admissible entropy variables and the signs of the bound-current ansatz. The second route is the statistical-mechanical one of Mazur, in which the macroscopic Maxwell equations are obtained by ensemble averaging over a system of atoms with internal charge carriers. Mazur stops before the conservation laws, so we derive them, and we estimate the size of the mass-correction terms that appear. The comparison shows that after a redefinition of polarisation and magnetisation the two sets of equations agree structurally. The only irreducible difference is a momentum contribution from microscopic field fluctuations, which can not be reproduced in a purely macroscopic theory. We further show that the electromotive intensity $\mathcal{E}$ and the Lorentz magnetisation $\mathcal{M}$ are not modelling choices but appear by themselves, and that the asymmetric look of the entropy function is a consequence of the chosen energy variable and not a defect of the theory.

AI.tldr: 本文重新审视了运动极化/磁化物质的连续介质热力学与电磁理论的耦合问题，比较了Dreyer等人的公理化体理论与Mazur的统计力学两条路径，证明二者在重新定义极化和磁化后在结构上一致，唯一不可约差异是微观场涨落产生的动量贡献。
AI.motivation: 连续介质热力学与电磁理论的耦合是经典但仍有争议的问题。Dreyer等人的公理化体理论与Mazur的统计力学路径看似不同，作者希望系统比较两者，澄清内能平衡源项、极化电流、洛伦兹磁化等关键量的物理本质，并解决熵函数不对称性的疑问。
AI.method: 作者沿两条路线进行：1) 在Dreyer-Guhlke-Müller的公理化理论中，指出内能平衡的源项必须由非对流电流构建，揭示极化电流与洛伦兹磁化通过单一恒等式联系，该恒等式同时固定熵变量和束缚电流假设的符号；2) 在Mazur的统计力学路径中，通过对具有内部电荷载体的原子系统进行系综平均得到宏观麦克斯韦方程，作者进一步推导守恒定律并估计质量修正项的大小。最后对两套方程进行结构比较。
AI.result: 两套方程在重新定义极化和磁化后结构上一致；唯一不可约差异是微观场涨落产生的动量贡献，无法在纯宏观理论中重现；电动势强度E和洛伦兹磁化M是自然出现的而非建模选择；熵函数的不对称外观是选择的能量变量的结果而非理论缺陷。
AI.conclusion: 作者证明了宏观公理化路径与微观统计力学路径在结构上兼容，澄清了多个看似为建模选择实际上是理论必然而非人为设定的量，并将不可约差异精确定位为微观场涨落效应。

title: Defect-Controlled Multiferroicity via Stacking Control in Nonmagnetic van der Waals Bilayers
summary: We present a general paradigm that directly couples vacancy-localized magnetism to interfacial sliding ferroelectricity in nonmagnetic van der Waals (vdWs) bilayers. Utilizing bilayer hexagonal boron nitride (hBN) as a prototypical vdWs host system, we use first-principles calculations to show that a single vacancy acts as a local registry sensor, lifting the degeneracy between polar sliding partners via a defect-centered polarization offset. For interlayer vacancy pairs, we discover a defect selectivity where the hosting sublattice fully dictates the interlayer exchange, stabilizing either ferrimagnetic or antiferromagnetic configurations. Applying an out-of-plane electric field selects the polar registry and drives an amplitude modulation of the compensated Néel order parameter. These findings establish a robust, sublattice-dependent engineering of multiferroic functionality via stacking control across a wide class of nonmagnetic 2D heterostructures.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种通用范式，通过将空位局域磁性直接耦合到界面滑动铁电性，在非磁性范德华双层材料中实现多铁性功能。以六方氮化硼双层为原型，第一性原理计算表明单个空位可作为局域排列传感器，通过缺陷中心的极化偏移解除极性滑移伙伴的简并；层间空位对的宿主子晶格完全决定层间交换，稳定亚铁磁或反铁磁构型；外加垂直电场可选择性极化解并驱动补偿尼尔序参量的振幅调制。
AI.motivation: 传统多铁性材料通常依赖磁性离子的存在，本文旨在探索在非磁性范德华双层体系中通过缺陷工程实现磁性-铁电耦合的可能性，为多功能二维异质结的设计提供新思路。
AI.method: 采用第一性原理计算方法，以双层六方氮化硼为原型体系，研究单空位和层间空位对在滑动铁电框架下的磁性行为，并通过外加电场调控极性排列状态。
AI.result: 发现单空位可打破极性滑移伙伴间的能量简并；空位对的宿主子晶格决定层间交换耦合类型（亚铁磁或反铁磁）；外电场可驱动极性排列并调制补偿尼尔序参量的振幅。
AI.conclusion: 该工作确立了通过堆叠控制实现子晶格依赖的多铁性工程，可推广至广泛的非磁性二维异质结构体系，为多功能器件提供新的设计维度。

title: Optimally embedded tight binding for reproducing geometry dependent observables
comment: Main: 18 pages, 7 figures, Appendix: 10 pages, 6 figures
summary: In tight-binding models, the position operator is reduced to intra-cell orbital positions (embeddings). While accurately reproducing band structures, such models often fail for geometry dependent responses depending on the position operator. To address this, we investigate the role of these embeddings and introduce the general framework of optimally embedded tight binding. Treating the embeddings as geometric tuning parameters to be fixed against a reference response (obtained from ab-initio computation or experiment), we obtain tight-binding models of GaAs and CdS which quantitatively reproduce non-linear optical responses at no cost to band structure accuracy. The optimal embeddings are determined efficiently using position derivatives obtained from decomposing tight-binding observables into a geometry independent and dependent part, and explicit derivatives are provided for key quantities such as the quantum geometric tensor. The decomposition reveals where geometric effects dominate, and we show in both toy models and in the Chern insulator V2O3 how geometry can dramatically alter the local metric trace. Our results highlight that orbital embeddings should be treated as a genuine model parameter which should be explicitly fixed against physical data to get accurate minimal models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"最优嵌入紧束缚"（optimally embedded tight binding）框架，将轨道嵌入位置视为几何调优参数，通过对参考响应（如从头算或实验数据）进行拟合来确定，从而在保持能带结构精度的同时定量复现非线性光学响应。作者在GaAs和CdS中验证了该方法，并展示了在Chern绝缘体V2O3中几何效应对局域度量迹的显著影响。
AI.motivation: 传统紧束缚模型中，位置算符被简化为胞内轨道位置（嵌入），虽然能准确再现能带结构，但在依赖几何（位置算符）的响应（如非线性光学响应）上常常失效。这是因为嵌入的选择对几何相关响应有显著影响，而此前未被系统处理。
AI.method: 1) 将轨道嵌入视为几何调优参数；2) 将紧束缚可观测量分解为几何无关和几何相关两部分，利用位置导数高效确定最优嵌入；3) 为量子几何张量等关键量提供解析导数；4) 针对参考响应（从头算或实验）进行拟合优化。
AI.result: 在GaAs和CdS中，该方法在不牺牲能带结构精度的前提下定量复现了非线性光学响应；在玩具模型和Chern绝缘体V2O3中展示了几何效应对局域度量迹的戏剧性改变。
AI.conclusion: 轨道嵌入应被视为真正的模型参数，需要明确地针对物理数据进行固定，才能获得准确的紧束缚最小模型，这对于依赖几何的响应计算至关重要。

title: Chemical potentials from structure factors: I. Neutral multi-component mixtures
summary: The chemical potentials of multi-component mixtures underlie many physical and chemical phenomena, but remain challenging to compute. The S0 method enables the computation of chemical potentials from equilibrium molecular dynamics simulations, by leveraging the thermodynamic relationship between particle number fluctuations and derivatives of chemical potentials, followed by numerical integration along different compositions. Here we generalize the S0 method from two-component mixtures to neutral multi-component mixtures. We first extend the statistical mechanical formalism to high-dimensional compositional space, and then introduce a Gaussian process integration scheme combined with active learning to efficiently integrate chemical potentials and sample diverse compositions. We use this method to compute the mixing free energies of a molten metal alloy, and the solubilities of two paracetamol polymorphs in water-ethanol solvents. The extended S0 method provides a practical and scalable route for computing chemical potentials in neutral bulk multi-component mixtures from atomistic simulations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种将S0方法从二元混合物推广到中性多元混合物的方法，通过将统计力学形式扩展到高维组分空间，并结合高斯过程积分与主动学习策略，高效计算多元混合物中的化学势，进而计算混合自由能和溶解度。
AI.motivation: 多组分混合物的化学势是许多物理化学现象的基础，但计算起来极具挑战性。现有的S0方法仅适用于二元混合物，无法处理更普遍的多组分体系，因此需要将其推广到中性多元混合物。
AI.method: 该方法首先将S0方法的统计力学形式推广到高维组分空间；随后引入高斯过程积分方案并结合主动学习，以高效地在不同组分间进行数值积分并采样多样的组分组合；最后通过平衡分子动力学模拟计算化学势。
AI.result: 该方法被用于计算熔融金属合金的混合自由能，以及两种对乙酰氨基酚多晶型物在水-乙醇溶剂中的溶解度，展示了其在实际体系中的适用性和有效性。
AI.conclusion: 扩展的S0方法为从原子模拟中计算中性块体多组分混合物的化学势提供了一条实用且可扩展的途径，能够处理更复杂的组分空间并加速化学势的数值积分。

title: Quantum Metric Induced Critical Current Anomaly in Flat Band Josephson Junctions
summary: In well-established theories of Josephson junctions, the superconducting critical current \( I_\mathrm{c} \) increases as the normal state conductance \( \mathcal{G} \) increases. However, in a recent experiment in twisted bilayer graphene (TBG) based Josephson junctions, unexpectedly, it was observed that the increase of the critical current is accompanied by a decrease of the normal state conductance. We call this phenomenon the critical current anomaly. In this work, we point out that in the TBG-based Josephson junction, due to the suppression of the conventional Josephson current by the flatness of the band and the quantum metric enabled Josephson current (QMJC), the critical current anomaly can occur. The QMJC appears if the quantum metric length is comparable or longer than the junction length. We show that both \( \mathcal{G} \) and \( I_\mathrm{c} \) have the conventional and the quantum metric contributions, and there are parameter regimes in which \( I_\mathrm{c} \) increases even when \( \mathcal{G} \) decreases. We first demonstrate the critical current anomaly by a simple modified Lieb-lattice model both analytically and numerically. The incredible consistency with the experimental results is demonstrated using a realistic six-band model of twisted bilayer graphene. Therefore, we suggest that the critical current anomaly observed in the experiment provide strong evidence of QMJC which were ignored in well-established theories of Josephson junctions.

AI.tldr: 本文解释了在转角双层石墨烯（TBG）约瑟夫森结中观察到的"临界电流异常"现象——即临界电流增大伴随正常态电导减小。研究表明，这一异常源于平带的量子度量贡献：当量子度量长度与结长相当时，量子度量约瑟夫森电流（QMJC）主导临界电流，而正常态电导的量子度量贡献方向相反，从而产生临界电流异常。作者通过修正的Lieb晶格模型和真实TBG六带模型证实了这一机制，为该现象提供了强有力的证据。
AI.motivation: 传统约瑟夫森结理论认为超导临界电流I_c随正常态电导G增大而增大，但近期TBG约瑟夫森结实验观察到相反趋势（I_c增大而G减小）。这一反常现象挑战了既有理论框架，需要新的物理机制来解释。
AI.method: 作者提出临界电流异常源于平带对常规约瑟夫森电流的抑制以及量子度量约瑟夫森电流（QMJC）的贡献。QMJC在量子度量长度大于或等于结长时出现。作者分别分析G和I_c的常规贡献与量子度量贡献，先在修正的Lieb晶格模型中解析和数值演示该异常，再用TBG的六带模型验证与实验一致。
AI.result: 研究发现存在参数区域使得I_c增大而G减小。修正的Lieb晶格模型解析和数值结果均展示了临界电流异常，且TBG六带模型与实验结果高度一致。
AI.conclusion: 实验观察到的临界电流异常为QMJC提供了强有力的证据，而这种量子度量贡献在传统约瑟夫森结理论中被忽略了。这一发现对理解平带超导和约瑟夫森结物理具有重要意义。

title: A comparative study of sum-connectivity and product-connectivity Gourava indices for benzenoid hydrocarbons
summary: This study evaluates the sum-connectivity ($SGO$) and product-connectivity ($PGO$) Gourava indices as molecular descriptors for benzenoid hydrocarbons. Using a dataset of 30 benzenoid structures, we compare least-squares regression models for predicting $π$-electronic energies ($E_π$) and find that $SGO$ yields a markedly better fit than $PGO$ across molecular edge types. The indices are further assessed using three validation designs: (i) correlation analysis, in which $SGO$ exhibits strong yet non-perfect inverse correlations with standard descriptors ($M_1, M_2, SO, DSO,$ and $ABS$; $r\in[-0.9923,-0.8936]$), suggesting complementary structural information; (ii) degeneracy analysis on Octane, Nonane, and order-$10$ tree datasets, where $SGO$ attains low degeneracy rates (22.22\%, 40.00\%, and 42.45\%); and (iii) structure-sensitivity analysis on trees of order $n=10$, showing 74\% higher sensitivity than $DSO$ while maintaining a high structure-abruptness ratio ($SA = 0.474386$). Overall, $SGO$ offers a favorable balance between discriminative power and numerical stability, supporting its applicability in QSPR modeling and related theoretical studies.

AI.tldr: 本研究评估了sum-connectivity（SGO）和product-connectivity（PGO）Gourava指标作为苯环碳氢化合物分子描述符的性能。基于30种苯环结构的数据集，SGO在预测π电子能量方面优于PGO，并通过相关性分析、退化性分析和结构敏感性分析三种验证设计，证明了SGO具有强判别力与数值稳定性的良好平衡，适用于QSPR建模。
AI.motivation: 寻找更有效的分子拓扑描述符，以提升对苯环碳氢化合物π电子能量的预测精度。传统的分子描述符存在判别力不足或数值不稳定的问题，需要探索新的Gourava指标在QSPR建模中的适用性。
AI.method: 使用30种苯环结构数据集，采用最小二乘回归模型比较SGO与PGO对π电子能量的预测能力；随后通过三种验证设计评估SGO：相关性分析（与M1、M2、SO、DSO、ABS等标准描述符对比）、退化性分析（在Octane、Nonane和阶数为10的树数据集上）、以及结构敏感性分析（与DSO比较，并计算结构突变比）。
AI.result: SGO在预测π电子能量方面显著优于PGO；SGO与标准描述符呈强但非完全的逆相关（r∈[-0.9923,-0.8936]），表明其具有互补的结构信息；SGO在三个数据集上的退化率分别为22.22%、40.00%和42.45%；结构敏感性比DSO高出74%，结构突变比为0.474386。
AI.conclusion: SGO在判别力和数值稳定性之间达到了有利的平衡，可作为QSPR建模及相关理论研究中有效的分子描述符。

title: Metallic Gross-Neveu criticality and superconductivity on the $\mathrm{SO}(3)$ SLAC fermion
summary: The realization of Dirac criticality beyond the conventional Gross-Neveu-Yukawa (GNY) paradigm has become a major frontier in condensed matter physics. In this work, we introduce an $\mathrm{SO}(3)$-symmetric bilayer SLAC fermion model with tunable inter-layer interactions that exhibits a rich quantum phase diagram. As the interaction strength increases, the system undergoes two distinct phase transitions. The primary transition is a continuous boundary separating a Dirac semimetal (DSM) from an $\mathrm{SO}(3)$-broken ordered phase. Crucially, this transition evades the standard GNY universality class because the emergent order only gaps out a subset of the itinerant fermions. Using large-scale quantum Monte Carlo (QMC) simulations, we establish that this transition belongs to the Gross-Neveu-$\mathrm{SO}(3)$ universality class with $N=6$ irreducible Dirac cones and precisely extract the corresponding critical exponents. At stronger couplings, a second transition drives the system into an inter-layer $\mathrm{SO}(3)$-symmetric superconducting (SC) state. We provide strong numerical evidence that this transition is a quantum-fluctuation-driven first-order transition. Our study provides new insights into the exploration of Dirac criticality beyond the standard GNY universality class, and also offers a novel platform to realize superconductivity featuring $\mathrm{SO}(3)$ symmetry.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个SO(3)对称的双层SLAC费米子模型，通过可调层间相互作用展现丰富的量子相图。系统经历两个相变：主相变是狄拉克半金属到SO(3)破缺有序相的连续相变，属于Gross-Neveu-SO(3)普适类（N=6个不可约狄拉克锥），超越了传统GNY范式；第二个相变在更强耦合下驱动系统进入层间SO(3)对称超导态，被证明是量子涨落驱动的一级相变。
AI.motivation: 探索超越传统Gross-Neveu-Yukawa(GNY)范式的狄拉克临界性，寻找新的量子临界普适类，并提供实现SO(3)对称超导的新型平台。
AI.method: 构建SO(3)对称的双层SLAC费米子模型，利用大尺度量子蒙特卡洛(QMC)模拟研究系统的相图和临界行为，提取临界指数。
AI.result: 主相变属于Gross-Neveu-SO(3)普适类（N=6个不可约狄拉克锥），精确提取了相应临界指数；第二相变到SO(3)对称超导态被证实为量子涨落驱动的一级相变。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为超越标准GNY普适类的狄拉克临界性探索提供了新见解，同时也为实现具有SO(3)对称性的超导提供了新颖平台。

title: Hexagonal Stacking Maximizes Proton Configurational Entropy among Ice-I Polytypes
comment: 14 pages, 4 figures. Supplemental Material included as appendices S1-S7
summary: Ice I admits cubic, hexagonal, and mixed layer stackings, but rigorous entropy comparisons have focused on the two ideal endmembers. We represent every cyclic uniform-registry stacking by a word in a nonnegative transfer operator K and its transpose. For every such even-length word, applying the Schatten-Hölder inequality proves that alternating hexagonal stacking maximizes the ice-rule count at every common finite cross-section; the configuration constant is therefore maximal among all periodic uniform-registry polytypes. We obtain the lower endpoint by restricting Nagle's positive even-subgraph expansion to exactly enumerated disjoint blocks. Finner's degree-two hypergraph Hölder inequality and rational Collatz-Wielandt certificates for two-replica prism transfer operators give the upper endpoints. These constructions yield $1.503360 \le w \le 1.540196$, with $w(\mathrm{Ic}) \le 1.527699$.

AI.tldr: 本文严格比较了冰I多型体中立方（Ic）、六方（Ih）和混合层堆叠的构型熵。通过转移算子K及其转置构造所有均匀堆叠词，利用Schatten-Hölder不等式证明交替六方堆叠在有限截面上使冰规则计数最大化，从而得到构型常数上界。通过Nagle正偶子图展开的精确枚举和Finner超图Hölder不等式等方法，将构型常数约束在1.503360到1.540196之间，其中立方冰Ic的常数不超过1.527699。
AI.motivation: 冰I相存在立方、六方和混合层堆叠等多种多型体，但此前严格的熵（构型常数）比较仅局限于立方和六方两种理想端元。作者希望推广到所有周期性均匀堆叠多型体，给出严谨的构型常数上下界。
AI.method: 将每个循环均匀堆叠表示为非负转移算子K及其转置上的词；对任意偶长度词应用Schatten-Hölder不等式证明交替六方堆叠最大化冰规则计数；下界通过限制Nagle正偶子图展开于精确枚举的不相交块获得；上界借助Finner二阶超图Hölder不等式及二副本棱柱转移算子的有理Collatz-Wielandt证书实现。
AI.result: 得到构型常数约束1.503360 ≤ w ≤ 1.540196，并特别给出w(Ic) ≤ 1.527699。这首次为所有周期性均匀多型体提供了统一严谨的构型常数比较框架。
AI.conclusion: 交替六方堆叠在所有周期性均匀注册多型体中具有最大构型常数，立方冰的构型常数上限被改进到1.527699，为冰多型体熵排序提供了严格的解析依据。

title: Understanding the Oxygen Reduction Reaction and Oxygen Evolution Reaction in Metal Intercalated Biphenylene Bilayers
summary: We conducted an {\it ab initio} study of the oxygen reduction reaction (ORR) and oxygen evolution reaction (OER) in metal-encapsulated biphenylene bilayers, B/M/B, with M = Ti, V, Cr, Mn, Fe, Co, Ni, Cu, Nb, Ru, W, Os and Pt. In most systems, the intercalated metal sits at the square carbon sites (C$^{468}$) of the biphenylene lattice. Using a computational hydrogen electrode approach, we evaluated the reaction energetics at these active sites. Several B/M/B systems show competitive ORR and OER performance. Among the investigated systems, Cu, Pt, Ru, and Mn exhibit the lowest ORR overpotentials of 0.42, 0.44, 0.50, and 0.56 V, respectively, while Fe is identified as the most active catalyst for OER with an overpotential of 0.44 V. To understand the catalytic trends, we looked at the electronic structure through the metal $d-$band centers, the C$^{468}$ $p_z-$band centers, and the corresponding orbital charge populations. The band centers did not give a simple polynomial dependence on the overpotentials, though they did point to favorable electronic ranges for the best catalysts. The $d-$orbital charge population of the encapsulated metal, however, correlated most clearly with activity-especially for OER-yielding volcano-type plots. From these, B/Fe/B emerges as the best OER catalyst, while B/Mn/B lies closest to the ORR optimum. The $p-$orbital population at the active carbon site also captures the main trends, albeit less strongly. Overall, these results show that straightforward electronic descriptors can predict catalytic behavior in metal-encapsulated biphenylene bilayers and guide the search for efficient catalysts where the carbon framework itself drives the reactivity.

AI.tldr: 本文通过从头计算（ab initio）研究了金属嵌入联苯撑双层（B/M/B，M为13种过渡金属）中氧还原反应（ORR）和析氧反应（OER）的催化性能，发现Cu、Pt、Ru、Mn具有最低的ORR过电位（0.42-0.56 V），Fe为最佳OER催化剂（过电位0.44 V），并揭示了金属d轨道电荷布居可作为预测催化活性的关键电子描述符。
AI.motivation: 寻找高效、可替代贵金属的ORR和OER催化剂，理解金属嵌入碳材料中的催化机理，并建立简单有效的电子描述符来预测和筛选高性能催化剂。
AI.method: 采用从头计算方法（ab initio），构建金属嵌入联苯撑双层结构B/M/B（M=Ti, V, Cr, Mn, Fe, Co, Ni, Cu, Nb, Ru, W, Os, Pt），使用计算氢电极（CHE）方法评估反应能量学，并通过金属d带中心、C^{468} p_z带中心及轨道电荷布居分析电子结构，建立描述符与过电位之间的关联。
AI.result: Cu、Pt、Ru、Mn的ORR过电位最低（0.42、0.44、0.50、0.56 V），Fe的OER过电位最低（0.44 V）。金属d轨道电荷布居与催化活性（尤其OER）呈现最清晰的火山型曲线关系；带中心虽不能给出简单多项式依赖，但能指示最佳催化剂的有利电子范围；活性碳位点的p轨道布居也能部分捕捉主要趋势。
AI.conclusion: B/Fe/B为最佳OER催化剂，B/Mn/B最接近ORR最优值。研究证明简单的电子描述符（尤其是金属d轨道电荷布居）可以预测金属嵌入联苯撑双层中的催化行为，为碳框架自身驱动反应活性的高效催化剂搜索提供指导。

title: Ferroelectric-controllable spin-orbit torque in two-dimensional multiferroic heterostructure
summary: Spin-orbit torque (SOT), which enables electrical control of magnetization, plays a crucial role in the development of next-generation spintronic devices. Realizing SOT in two-dimensional van der Waals systems, together with achieving efficient nonvolatile manipulation via ferroelectricity, would be highly beneficial for the implementation of tunable logic devices with enhanced storage density. In this work, based on first-principles calculation and using a multiferroic Fe$_{3}$GeTe$_{2}$/In$_{2}$Se$_{3}$ heterostructure as a representative example, we demonstrate that switching the ferroelectric polarization of the In$_{2}$Se$_{3}$ layer induces a pronounced modification in the magnetization-dependent distribution of torkance within the heterostructure. Specifically, when the magnetization is in the plane, where the torque is maximal, reversing the polarization of In$_{2}$Se$_{3}$ from upward to downward enhances the total torkance to more than 150% of its original value. This substantial variation primarily originates from the polarization-induced modulation of the $z$ component of the time-reversal-odd torkance, which is mainly associated with an approximately 233% change in the atomic-resolved torque contributed from the middle Fe layer in Fe$_{3}$GeTe$_{2}$ layer. Further analysis reveals that the electronic states near $Γ$ on the Fermi surface undergo significant reconstruction upon polarization switching, which is responsible for the observed variation in the time-reversal-odd torque. Our results not only provide new insights into the functional potential of van der Waals multiferroic heterostructures, but also offer a viable strategy for achieving electrically tunable SOT, paving the way for future programmable spintronic devices.

AI.tldr: 本文通过第一性原理计算，研究了多铁性Fe₃GeTe₂/In₂Se₃范德华异质结中的自旋轨道矩（SOT）。研究发现，切换In₂Se₃层的铁电极化方向可显著改变异质结中的torkance分布，特别是当磁化在面内时，极化从向上翻转为向下可使总torkance增强至原始值的150%以上，这主要源于中间Fe层的原子分辨扭矩约233%的变化以及费米面附近Γ点电子态的重构。
AI.motivation: 自旋轨道矩（SOT）对实现磁化的电控至关重要，是下一代自旋电子学器件的核心。在二维范德华体系中实现SOT，并结合铁电性实现高效非易失调控，对于构建可调逻辑器件和提升存储密度具有重要意义。然而，如何在范德华体系中实现铁电可调的SOT仍是一个开放问题。
AI.method: 基于第一性原理计算，以多铁性Fe₃GeTe₂/In₂Se₃异质结为模型体系。通过计算不同铁电极化方向（向上和向下）下异质结中与磁化相关的torkance分布，分析极化切换对总torkance、时间反演奇性torkance的z分量以及原子分辨扭矩的影响，并结合费米面附近的电子态结构分析揭示其微观机制。
AI.result: 当磁化在面内（扭矩最大时），将In₂Se₃极化从向上翻转为向下可将总torkance增强到原始值的150%以上。该变化主要源于极化诱导的时间反演奇性torkance的z分量调制，其中Fe₃GeTe₂层中间Fe层贡献的原子分辨扭矩变化约233%。电子态分析显示，极化切换导致费米面附近Γ点的电子态发生显著重构，这是时间反演奇性扭矩变化的根本原因。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为范德华多铁异质结的功能潜力提供了新见解，证明了通过铁电极化切换实现电可调SOT的可行性，为未来可编程自旋电子器件的实现提供了可行策略。

title: Lee-Yang Theory Guided Force Field Refinement Based on Phase Diagrams
summary: We propose a general framework for automatic force field refinement guided by phase diagrams, grounded in Lee-Yang phase transition theory. The central idea is to directly use the partition function modulus as a phase-diagram-guided optimization target. Evaluating the modulus at points close to the real axis, where the Lee-Yang zeros are mostly associated with the phase transition, is more physically meaningful and avoids the numerical difficulty of explicitly solving for the zeros. This approach requires no system-specific order parameters or response properties for characterizing phase transition points, making it universal across various discontinuous phase transitions and material systems. We validate the method on refining parameters of a Lennard-Jones potential covering both gas-liquid and solid-liquid transitions, and a Cu embedded-atom method potential based on experimental melting curves. The refined force fields reproduce the target phase diagrams with significant improvement across all systems. For Cu, the refinement simultaneously improves predictions of enthalpy and heat capacity, which are observables beyond the optimization target. These results establish Lee-Yang theory as a practical tool for contemporary force field development.

AI.tldr: 提出一个基于Lee-Yang相变理论的通用力场优化框架，通过配分函数模量作为优化目标，无需系统特定的序参量或响应属性，即可在不同不连续相变和材料系统中自动优化力场参数，在Lennard-Jones势和Cu EAM势上均显著改善相图预测。
AI.motivation: 传统力场优化通常依赖系统特定的序参量或响应属性来表征相变点，缺乏通用性。作者希望建立一个不依赖特定系统性质的通用框架，能够自动优化力场参数以复现目标相图。
AI.method: 基于Lee-Yang相变理论，将配分函数模量直接作为优化目标。与在实轴附近评价模量（此处Lee-Yang零点主要与相变相关），避免显式求解零点的数值困难。该目标无需序参量或响应属性，适用于各种不连续相变。在Lennard-Jones势（涵盖气-液和固-液相变）及Cu EAM势上验证。
AI.result: 优化后的力场在所有系统中显著改善了目标相图的复现。对于Cu，还同时改善了焓和热容的预测——这些是超出优化目标的可观测物理量。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明Lee-Yang理论可以成为现代力场开发的实用工具，为不依赖系统特定性质的通用力场优化提供了新途径。

title: Excitron-Induced Pair Fluctuations Reveal Superconductivity in the Electron Gas
comment: 10 pages, 5 figures. Supplemental Material (7 pages, takada_SM.pdf) included
summary: Understanding how superconductivity can emerge in dilute electronic systems remains a central challenge in condensed matter physics. By performing first-principles calculations of the electron self-energy Σ(k,iw_n) in the low-density three-dimensional electron gas, we identify a sharp divergence at r_s ~ 8 and T ~ 10^{-4}E_ F, signaling a second-order phase transition. This critical behavior originates from one-dimensional superconducting fluctuations mediated by virtual excitations of an excitron---a quasi-1D electronic composite formed by an electron and longitudinal electron-hole pairs. Although the superconducting mechanism itself is plasmon-mediated, the excitron channel provides a unique window into its fluctuation dynamics. Near the transition, we observe a pseudogap and a linear-in-T inverse electron lifetime, reminiscent of phenomena in high-T_c materials. These results reveal an unexpected route by which plasmon-driven superconductivity manifests in the dilute 3D electron gas through quasi-1D excitron dynamics.

AI.tldr: 本文通过第一性原理计算低密度三维电子气的电子自能Σ(k,iw_n)，发现r_s≈8、T≈10⁻⁴E_F处存在尖锐发散，标志着二级相变。该临界行为源于一维超导涨落，由激子（exciton）——电子与纵向电子-空穴对形成的准一维复合体——的虚激发所介导。超导机制本身由等离激元介导，但激子通道为涨落动力学提供了独特窗口。相变附近观察到赝隙和线性T的电子逆寿命，类似高温超导材料的现象。
AI.motivation: 理解在稀释电子系统中超导性如何涌现仍是凝聚态物理的核心挑战。本文旨在揭示低密度三维电子气中等离激元驱动的超导性如何通过准一维激子动力学表现出来，解决该系统中超导机制的未解之谜。
AI.method: 采用第一性原理计算方法，计算低密度三维电子气中的电子自能Σ(k,iw_n)，分析其在参数空间（r_s与温度T）中的行为，识别相变临界点并研究涨落通道的物理来源。
AI.result: 在r_s~8和T~10⁻⁴E_F处发现电子自能的尖锐发散，表明存在二级相变；该临界行为来自一维超导涨落，由激子虚激发介导；在相变附近观察到赝隙和线性T的电子逆寿命特征。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了一条意想不到的路径：在稀释3D电子气中，等离激元驱动的超导性通过准一维激子动力学表现出来。这一发现不仅阐明了稀释系统中的超导机制，还揭示了与高温超导材料相似的共性现象，为理解复杂超导物理提供了新视角。

title: Quantum geometric localization length and localization criticality in an ideally flat Chern band
comment: 8 pages and 4 figures for the main text; 13 pages, 8 figures and 2 tables for SM
summary: We propose that the localization length in an isolated, ideally flat Chern band is set by quantum geometry. We explore the corresponding localization transition and its critical scaling by applying transfer matrix calculations in the maximally localized hybrid Wannier basis, whose spatial spread is exactly characterized by a quantum geometric length. Remarkably, upon tuning the quantum metric of the Chern band, we observe a crossover from a universal regime controlled by the Dirac fixed point to a non-universal regime with continuously varying critical exponents. Within the universal regime, the localization length exhibits a pronounced linear dependence on the quantum geometric length, supporting its quantum geometric nature. These findings provide a novel quantum geometric perspective on the localization in quantum Hall systems such as twisted moiré superlattices, and shed new light on the long-standing controversy over the criticality of the integer quantum Hall transition.

AI.tldr: 本文提出孤立理想平坦Chern带的局域化长度由量子几何决定，并通过转移矩阵计算研究其局域化转变及临界标度行为。
AI.motivation: 探索Chern带中局域化与量子几何之间的关系，并尝试解决整数量子霍尔转变临界性的长期争议。
AI.method: 在最大局域化混合Wannier基中应用转移矩阵计算，该基的空间展宽恰好由量子几何长度表征，通过调节Chern带的量子度量来研究局域化转变。
AI.result: 观察到从Dirac不动点控制的普适区到临界指数连续变化的非普适区的交叉行为；在普适区内局域化长度对量子几何长度呈显著线性依赖。
AI.conclusion: 为量子霍尔系统（如扭转莫尔超晶格）中的局域化提供了新颖的量子几何视角，并为整数量子霍尔转变的临界性争议提供了新的洞见。

title: Fuzzy Spectroscopy of Bound States in Massive Quantum Field Theories
summary: Mesons and glueballs are paradigmatic bound states of confining quantum field theories (QFTs), but their nonperturbative spectroscopy in the continuum remains challenging beyond one spatial dimension. Here we perform such spectroscopy for the Ising QFT using a recently developed regularization based on noncommutative ``fuzzy'' geometry. On a thin fuzzy torus, we reproduce the universal low-lying $\mathbb E_8$ meson masses of the magnetically perturbed $(1{+}1)\mathrm{D}$ Ising QFT. By increasing the torus aspect ratio, we continuously track the second-lightest $\mathbb E_8$ meson as the system effectively crosses over from 1D to 2D. On the 2D fuzzy torus and sphere, we find a subthreshold scalar level and above-threshold response features consistent with previous estimates of glueball masses. The same excitations are revealed away from equilibrium using quench dynamics. Our results establish fuzzy geometries as nonperturbative spectroscopic probes of massive QFTs, including their bound-state evolution through dimensional crossover.

AI.tldr: 本文利用非交换"模糊"几何正则化方法，对Ising量子场论进行了非微扰谱学研究。在薄模糊环面上重现了(1+1)维Ising QFT的E8介子质量；通过增大环面纵横比，连续追踪了从1D到2D维度交叉过程中第二轻E8介子的演化；在二维模糊环面和球面上发现了与胶球质量估计一致的亚阈值标量能级和超阈值响应特征，并通过淬火动力学在非平衡态中揭示了相同的激发。该工作确立了模糊几何作为强耦合QFT非微扰谱学探针的有效性。
AI.motivation: 介子和胶球是禁闭量子场论中的典型束缚态，但在超过一维空间后，其连续介质中的非微扰谱学仍然具有挑战性。作者旨在开发一种能够处理更高维度下强耦合QFT束缚态谱学的新方法，并追踪束缚态从低维到高维的维度交叉演化。
AI.method: 采用基于非交换"模糊"几何的正则化方法对Ising QFT进行谱学研究：(1) 在薄模糊环面上通过调节纵横比实现从(1+1)D到(2+1)D的维度交叉模拟；(2) 在二维模糊环面和球面上研究标量能级和响应特征；(3) 使用淬火动力学（quench dynamics）在非平衡态下揭示相同的束缚态激发。
AI.result: 在薄模糊环面上成功复现了磁微扰Ising QFT的E8介子质量；通过调节纵横比追踪了维度交叉过程中第二轻E8介子的连续演化；在二维模糊几何上发现了与胶球质量估计一致的亚阈值标量能级和超阈值响应特征。
AI.conclusion: 模糊几何方法可作为一种有效的非微扰谱学探针，用于研究大规模QFT中的束缚态，包括通过维度交叉追踪束缚态的演化。这一方法为超越一维空间的强耦合QFT谱学研究提供了新的工具。

title: Sn-Doping in LPCVD-Grown (010) $β$-Ga$_2$O$_3$ Films
summary: In this work, Sn-doped (010) $β$-Ga$_2$O$_3$ homoepitaxial films were grown by low-pressure chemical vapor deposition (LPCVD), and the influence of Sn incorporation on their structural, morphological, and electrical properties was systematically investigated. Controlled room-temperature carrier concentrations ranging from $1.17 \times 10^{17}$ to $3.06 \times 10^{18}$ cm$^{-3}$ were achieved, with corresponding Hall mobilities decreasing from 113 to 63 cm$^2$ V$^{-1}$ s$^{-1}$. The films exhibited the monoclinic $β$-Ga$_2$O$_3$ phase, near-stoichiometric composition, and well-defined step-flow morphology, with a minimum rocking-curve FWHM of 68.4 arcsec and an RMS roughness of 2.63 nm. Film thicknesses ranging from 1.66 to 11.3 $μ$m were obtained at growth rates of 6.4 to 16.6 $μ$m h$^{-1}$, demonstrating the ability of LPCVD to produce thick epitaxial layers. The sample with a room-temperature carrier concentration of $1.17 \times 10^{17}$ cm$^{-3}$ exhibited room-temperature and low-temperature Hall mobilities of 113 cm$^2$ V$^{-1}$ s$^{-1}$ and 380 cm$^2$ V$^{-1}$ s$^{-1}$ at 84 K, respectively. Both represent the highest reported values for LPCVD-grown Sn-doped $β$-Ga$_2$O$_3$. Transport modeling of the same sample yielded a shallow donor activation energy of 32.7 meV, a deeper donor level at 95 meV, and a low compensating acceptor concentration of $2.0 \times 10^{16}$ cm$^{-3}$, indicating efficient donor activation and a low degree of compensation. These results demonstrate that LPCVD enables controlled Sn doping while maintaining excellent structural and electrical quality, providing a viable route for realizing thick $β$-Ga$_2$O$_3$ epitaxial drift layers.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过低压化学气相沉积(LPCVD)在(010)β-Ga₂O₃衬底上生长Sn掺杂同质外延薄膜，系统研究了Sn掺入对薄膜结构、形态和电学性质的影响。实现了1.17×10¹⁷至3.06×10¹⁸ cm⁻³的可控室温载流子浓度，霍尔迁移率从113降至63 cm²V⁻¹s⁻¹。最佳样品在室温和84 K下分别获得113和380 cm²V⁻¹s⁻¹的霍尔迁移率，均为LPCVD生长的Sn掺杂β-Ga₂O₃的最高报道值。输运建模揭示浅施主激活能32.7 meV、深施主能级95 meV及低补偿受主浓度2.0×10¹⁶ cm⁻³，证明LPCVD可实现高效施主激活和低补偿的高质量厚外延层。
AI.motivation: β-Ga₂O₃作为超宽禁带半导体在功率器件领域具有巨大潜力，而实现可控掺杂的高质量厚外延漂移层是制备高性能垂直功率器件的关键。Sn作为β-Ga₂O₃的重要浅施主掺杂剂，其在LPCVD生长中的可控掺入及对薄膜质量的影响尚需系统研究。
AI.method: 采用低压化学气相沉积(LPCVD)在(010)β-Ga₂O₃衬底上生长Sn掺杂同质外延薄膜，系统表征了Sn掺入对薄膜结构(单斜相、X射线摇摆曲线)、形貌(台阶流生长、表面粗糙度)、电学性质(载流子浓度、霍尔迁移率)的影响，并结合输运建模分析施主激活能和补偿受主浓度。
AI.result: 实现了1.17×10¹⁷至3.06×10¹⁸ cm⁻³的室温载流子浓度可控调节；最佳样品室温及84 K霍尔迁移率分别为113和380 cm²V⁻¹s⁻¹，创LPCVD生长的Sn掺杂β-Ga₂O₃最高记录；薄膜具有良好结晶质量(FWHM最低68.4 arcsec)和光滑表面(RMS 2.63 nm)；输运建模得到32.7 meV浅施主、95 meV深施主能级和2.0×10¹⁶ cm⁻³的低补偿受主浓度。
AI.conclusion: LPCVD能够实现Sn的可控掺杂，同时保持优异的结构和电学质量，为制备厚β-Ga₂O₃外延漂移层提供了一条可行路线，对推动β-Ga₂O₃基功率器件的发展具有重要意义。

title: Dynamical quantum phase transitions in a hybrid quantum dot system with superconducting and ferromagnetic leads
summary: We theoretically explore the non-equilibrium dynamics of a single quantum dot system coupled to both ferromagnetic and superconducting electrodes. To investigate its time evolution, we utilize the time-dependent numerical renormalization group technique, which captures the system's response to abrupt parameter changes in a fully non-perturbative manner. Our analysis focuses on dynamics following a sudden modification in the couplings to the leads or a shift of the orbital level. In particular, we calculate the time evolution of the induced local superconducting pairing correlations and magnetization. In this context, the relevant energy spectra are examined. Moreover, we study the behavior of the Loschmidt echo and the return function to shed light on the signatures of dynamical quantum phase transitions. The determined dependencies reveal non-trivial competition between relevant correlations, involving superconducting pairing and ferromagnetic-contacted induced exchange field, and deepen our understanding of nanoscale hybrid systems' dynamical behavior.

AI.tldr: 本文利用时间依赖数值重整化群技术，理论上研究了量子点与铁磁和超导电极耦合的非平衡动力学，重点关注突变耦合或轨道能级变化后，局域超导配对关联和磁化强度的时间演化，以及Loschmidt回声所揭示的动态量子相变特征。
AI.motivation: 混合纳米系统中超导配对与铁磁感应交换场之间存在竞争关系，理解这些系统在非平衡条件下的动力学行为对于深化对纳米尺度混合系统物理的理解至关重要。
AI.method: 采用时间依赖数值重整化群技术，以完全非微扰方式处理突然改变电极耦合或轨道能级后的系统响应；计算超导配对关联和磁化强度的时间演化，并分析能量谱、Loschmidt回声和返回函数。
AI.result: 研究揭示了超导配对与铁磁接触诱导交换场之间的非平凡竞争关系，通过能量谱分析和动态量子相变特征验证了这种竞争效应。
AI.conclusion: 该研究加深了对纳米尺度混合系统（量子点-铁磁-超导结）动力学行为的理解，展示了超导与铁磁效应在非平衡动力学中的相互作用与竞争。

title: Prediction of BaBiO$_3$-like superconducting perovskites in K-doped SrAsO$_3$
summary: Using first-principles calculations, we predict a new perovskite compound SrAsO$_3$ . The undoped cubic phase has pronounced soft-phonon instabilities, which are gradually suppressed upon K doping the Sr site. The cubic phase becomes dynamically stable for K-doping levels above approximately 60%, and the stabilized K-doped phases are metallic with predicted conventional phonon mediated superconductivity. Moreover, the inclusion of nonlocal exchange interactions broadens the electronic bandwidth, enhances the electron-phonon coupling (EPC) strength, and increases the superconducting transition temperature ($T_c$) of these doped compounds. In particular, the HSE06 hybrid exchange-correlation functional corrected EPC constant $λ$ reaches 1.41 for Sr$_{0.4}$K$_{0.6}$AsO$_3$, corresponding to a predicted $T_c$ of 44.3 K. These results suggest that SrAsO$_3$ is a BaBiO$_3$-like superconducting perovskite driven by strong electron-phonon coupling.

AI.tldr: 通过第一性原理计算预测了新型钙钛矿化合物SrAsO₃，发现其立方相具有软声子不稳定性，但在K掺杂后变得动态稳定，并展现出常规声子介导的超导性，其中HSE06杂化泛函预测的T_c可达44.3 K。
AI.motivation: 探索新型钙钛矿超导材料，特别是寻找类似BaBiO₃这类具有强电子-声子耦合驱动的超导体系。
AI.method: 采用第一性原理计算，结合HSE06杂化泛函修正，研究SrAsO₃及其K掺杂体系的声子稳定性、电子结构、电子-声子耦合强度及超导转变温度。
AI.result: K掺杂超过约60%时立方相变得动态稳定；Sr₀.₄K₀.₆AsO₃的电子-声子耦合常数λ达1.41，预测T_c为44.3 K；非局域交换作用的引入增强了带宽、EPC强度和T_c。
AI.conclusion: SrAsO₃是一种类似BaBiO₃的强电子-声子耦合驱动的超导钙钛矿，K掺杂是实现其超导性的关键调控手段。

title: Finite-Temperature Spin-Adapted ROKS and TDDFT
summary: Finite-temperature conditions constitute a central regime of interest in quantum chemistry. Nonetheless, a consistent incorporation of finite-temperature effects into density functional theory (DFT) for both ground and excited states, while rigorously preserving the spin-symmetry associated with the $\hat{S}^2$ operator, has not yet been achieved. In this work, we develop a finite-temperature extension of restricted open-shell Kohn-Sham (ROKS) theory and spin-adapted time-dependent density functional theory (TDDFT), providing unified frameworks for the description of ground and excited states, respectively. For finite-temperature ROKS, we construct a canonical ensemble by using integer high-spin ROKS components, where each component $I$ has the same spin number $|SS \rangle$ and its weight $w_I$ follows the Boltzmann distribution. For finite-temperature spin-adapted TDDFT, every integer component $I$ supplies an ordinary zero-temperature spin-adapted TDDFT matrix pair $(\Mmat_I,\Nmat_I)$. These matrices are arranged in one unified spatial-orbital order and then averaged. In the zero-temperature single-component limit, the theory reduces to ordinary high-spin ROKS and the corresponding spin-adapted TDDFT. As a numerical application, we apply the theory to a diradicaloid and use the calculated excitations to interpret the thermally activated absorption observed in variable-temperature UV/Vis spectroscopy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了有限温度下的受限开壳层Kohn-Sham（ROKS）理论和自旋适应含时密度泛函理论（TDDFT）扩展，通过使用整数高自旋ROKS分量的正则系综来构造有限温度框架，每个分量具有相同的自旋数|SS⟩且权重服从Boltzmann分布。在零温度单分量极限下，理论退化为普通的高自旋ROKS和相应的自旋适应TDDFT。作者将该理论应用于双自由基体系，用计算出的激发态解释了变温UV/Vis光谱中观察到的热活化吸收。
AI.motivation: 有限温度条件在量子化学中至关重要，但现有的DFT方法未能同时在基态和激发态中一致地纳入有限温度效应，同时严格保持与Ŝ²算符相关的自旋对称性。这一空缺阻碍了热活化过程（如热激发吸收）的准确描述。
AI.method: 1) 有限温度ROKS：通过使用整数高自旋ROKS分量构造正则系综，每个分量I具有相同自旋数|SS⟩，权重w_I服从Boltzmann分布。2) 有限温度自旋适应TDDFT：每个整数分量I提供普通零温度自旋适应TDDFT矩阵对(M_I, N_I)，这些矩阵按统一空间轨道顺序排列后取平均。3) 在零温度单分量极限下退化为标准高自旋ROKS和自旋适应TDDFT。
AI.result: 作者将该方法应用于双自由基体系，成功用计算得到的激发态解释了变温UV/Vis光谱中观察到的热活化吸收现象，验证了方法的实用性和物理合理性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作首次实现了在有限温度下同时处理基态和激发态的DFT框架，既能保持自旋对称性，又能统一描述热平衡条件下的电子结构。该方法为解释变温光谱实验提供了有力的理论工具。

title: Momentum-Selective Electron and Spin Dynamics under Ultrafast Photoexcitation
summary: Recent advances in time-resolved spectroscopies have enabled direct access to the momentum-selective nonequilibrium dynamics of correlated quantum materials, revealing a strongly momentum-dependent response of electrons and collective excitations. Interpreting these observations requires a real-time theoretical framework that consistently captures the interplay between strong local electronic correlations and nonlocal collective fluctuations, a capability that remains beyond state-of-the-art nonequilibrium approaches. Using a recently developed real-time many-body framework, we resolve the momentum-selective ultrafast dynamics of a photoexcited correlated electron system. We predict a transient nodal-antinodal anisotropy in electronic heating, providing a microscopic explanation for the momentum-dependent response debated in time-resolved photoemission and Raman experiments, and identify the nonthermal spectral-weight transfer responsible for the transient antinodal in-gap states observed in ultrafast photoemission. We further uncover a momentum-selective magnetic response, in which antiferromagnetic fluctuations undergo a strongly nonthermal, quench-like excitation far above the electronic temperature while preserving their correlation length, before relaxing through a momentum-space magnon cascade toward lower-momentum modes. Finally, by tracking the real-time local spin susceptibility, we identify a dynamical, experimentally accessible signature of local-moment formation and its photoinduced melting. Our results establish a unified microscopic picture of ultrafast electronic and magnetic dynamics, providing a framework for interpreting momentum-resolved pump-probe experiments.

AI.tldr: 本文利用实时多体理论框架，解析了光激发关联电子系统中动量选择性超快动力学，揭示了电子加热的节点-反节点各向异性、反铁磁涨落的非热激励现象、动量空间磁振子级联，以及局域磁矩形成和光致熔化的动力学特征，为动量分辨泵浦-探测实验提供了统一微观框架。
AI.motivation: 时间分辨光谱学已能直接观测关联量子材料中动量选择性的非平衡动力学，但解释这些观测需要能够同时捕捉强局域电子关联与非局域集体涨落相互作用的实时理论框架，而现有非平衡方法无法胜任。
AI.method: 采用近期发展的实时多体理论框架，对光激发关联电子系统的动量选择性超快动力学进行理论解析。
AI.result: 预测了瞬态节点-反节点各向异性的电子加热，解释了时间分辨光发射和拉曼实验中争论的动量依赖响应；识别了导致瞬态反节点带内隙态的非热谱权重转移；发现了反铁磁涨落经历远超电子温度的非热淬火式激励，同时保持其关联长度，并通过动量空间磁振子级联向低动量模式弛豫；通过追踪实时局域自旋磁化率，识别了局域磁矩形成及其光致熔化的动力学可观测特征。
AI.conclusion: 建立了光激发电子和磁性超快动力学的统一微观图像，为动量分辨泵浦-探测实验提供了理论解释框架。

title: Classical fractons with cosmological fixed points
summary: Classical fractons are Hamiltonian systems that can develop attractors after projection onto configuration or shape variables, although the full phase space admits none. We study a scale-invariant, dipole-conserving two-parameter family of fracton Hamiltonians $H_{α,β}$. By separating coordinates into scale and shape, we obtain autonomous shape dynamics that admit fixed points which leave a purely scale evolution of the form $R(t)\propto |t|^{α/(α-β)}$. The shape fixed points, which determine the distribution of the expanding particles, are central configurations of power-law Riesz potentials. The distinguished model $(α,β)=(-2,1)$ is unique: its scale evolution takes the Einstein-de Sitter form $R(t)\propto |t|^{2/3}$, its fixed-point equation is the equal-mass Newtonian central-configuration, its large-$N$ distribution is a homogeneous ball, and its homothetic trajectories admit a zero-energy Newtonian gravitational dual. The fixed points are locally stable, and simulations at moderate $N$ approach them from random initial data. Large $N$ simulations reveal a richer class of fixed-points: bound clusters of approximately fixed physical size retain internal motion, while their centers approach unequal-mass Newtonian central configurations and preserve large-scale homogeneity. A scale-separation conjecture yields an effective unequal-mass fracton dynamics for the centers and a corresponding zero-energy Newtonian gravitational dual. Trajectories generically exhibit a bidirectional arrow of time: scale and shape complexity grow away from a Janus point, while Boltzmann entropy grows logarithmically. Together, these features reproduce the salient structure of a flat matter-dominated cosmology. In the distinguished fracton model, all these cosmological analogues emerge as attractor properties, making it a toy model for cosmological dynamics without fine-tuning.

AI.tldr: 本文研究一类尺度不变、偶极矩守恒的fracton Hamiltonian系统族H_{α,β}，其形状动力学存在吸引子固定点，导致纯尺度演化R(t)∝|t|^{α/(α-β)}。其中特殊模型(α,β)=(-2,1)展现出Einstein-de Sitter尺度演化、等质量Newton中心构型以及均匀球分布等宇宙学类比特征，可作为无需精细调节的宇宙学动力学玩具模型。
AI.motivation: 经典fracton系统在投影到构型或形状变量后可以发展出吸引子，尽管全相空间不存在吸引子。作者希望理解这类系统的演化行为，并探索其与宇宙学动力学（特别是平坦物质主导宇宙）之间的深层联系。
AI.method: 将坐标分离为尺度和形状变量，得到自治的形状动力学方程。分析其固定点（对应Riesz势的中央构型），通过小N模拟验证固定点稳定性，并通过大N模拟发现更丰富的固定点类别（有界团簇+不等质量Newton中央构型）。提出尺度分离猜想，推导有效的fracton动力学及其Newton引力对偶。
AI.result: 固定点在局域上是稳定的，中等N随机初始数据可收敛到它们。大N模拟显示有界团簇保留内部运动，其中心逼近不等质量Newton中央构型并保持大尺度均匀性。轨迹呈现双向时间箭头：尺度和形状复杂度从Janus点增长，Boltzmann熵对数增长。特殊模型(α,β)=(-2,1)的尺度演化取Einstein-de Sitter形式R(t)∝|t|^{2/3}，且其大N分布为均匀球。
AI.conclusion: 在特殊fracton模型中，所有宇宙学类比特征（尺度演化、中心构型、熵增长、时间箭头）都作为吸引子性质自发涌现，无需精细调节，使其成为研究宇宙学动力学的理想玩具模型。这一发现将fracton系统与宇宙学在动力学层面建立了实质性联系。

title: Spin selective non-van der Waal electride nature in manganese under ambient pressure
summary: Electrides are an unusual class of ionic materials in which electrons localized in non-nuclear, interstitial regions act as anions within the crystal lattice. Here, we employ first-principles quantum mechanical calculations to investigate the structural, electronic, magnetic, and electride characteristics of elemental manganese (Mn) at an ambient pressure (0 GPa), focusing on its three crystalline phases: cubic ($α$)-Mn ($I\bar{4}3m,no.217$), cubic ($β$)-Mn ($P4_132, no.213$), and hexagonal ($hex$)-Mn ($P6_3/mmc, no.194$). Our calculations reveal pronounced interstitial-electron character in all three phases, accompanied by spin-selective electron localization function (ELF), establishing elemental Mn as a non-van der Waals electride system. Bader charge analysis indicates substantial electron redistribution from the Mn host framework toward the interstitial anionic-electron (IAE) regions, with an effective charge transfer of approximately $-1.645e$, $-1.477e$, and $-1.083e$ per interstitial basin in $α$-Mn, $β$-Mn, and $hex$-Mn, respectively. The electride character is further supported by the electronic density of states, where the IAE-associated states exhibit finite contributions near the Fermi level ($E_F$) and coexist with Mn-derived states, demonstrating their direct participation in the low-energy electronic structure. The combined electron localization function (ELF), effective charge transfer, and electron population due to IAE at $E_F$ therefore provide consistent evidence for interstitial anionic electrons in elemental Mn. To the best of our knowledge, this work provides the first systematic identification of spin-selective electride character in elemental Mn at ambient pressure, highlighting the possibility of exploiting its interstitial-electron states for unconventional electronic and magnetic functionalities.

AI.tldr: 本文通过第一性原理量子力学计算，系统研究了环境压力下元素锰(Mn)的三种晶相（α-Mn、β-Mn、hex-Mn）的结构、电子、磁性和电子化合物特性。研究发现所有三种相均表现出显著的间隙电子特征，具有自旋选择性电子局域函数(ELF)，将元素Mn确立为非范德华电子化合物体系。Bader电荷分析显示电子从Mn框架向间隙阴离子电子(IAE)区域发生明显转移，电荷转移量分别为α-Mn的-1.645e、β-Mn的-1.477e和hex-Mn的-1.083e。这是首次在环境压力下的元素Mn中系统鉴定出自旋选择性电子化合物特性。
AI.motivation: 电子化合物是一种不寻常的离子材料，其中局域在非核间隙区域的电子在晶格中充当阴离子。此前尚未有人系统研究元素锰在环境压力下是否表现出电子化合物特性，本研究旨在填补这一空白，探索元素Mn中是否存在间隙阴离子电子及其潜在功能。
AI.method: 采用第一性原理量子力学计算，对元素锰的三种晶相（α-Mn、β-Mn、hex-Mn）进行分析。使用自旋选择性电子局域函数(ELF)评估电子局域化特征，通过Bader电荷分析量化电荷转移，并结合电子态密度(DOS)分析间隙阴离子电子(IAE)在费米能级附近的贡献。
AI.result: 三种晶相均表现出显著的间隙电子特征，具有自旋选择性ELF，确立Mn为非范德华电子化合物体系。Bader分析表明有效电荷转移约为α-Mn的-1.645e、β-Mn的-1.477e和hex-Mn的-1.083e（每个间隙盆地）。DOS分析显示IAE相关态在费米能级附近有有限贡献并与Mn衍生态共存，表明IAE直接参与低能电子结构。
AI.conclusion: ELF、有效电荷转移和IAE在费米能级处的电子占据三者提供了一致的证据，证明元素Mn中存在间隙阴离子电子。这是首次在环境压力下系统鉴定出元素Mn的自旋选择性电子化合物特性，为利用其间隙电子态实现非常规电子和磁性功能提供了可能。

title: Probing intermittent polariton vortex dynamics with two-point correlations
summary: Superconducting single-photon detectors with time resolution of 80 ps have been used to study the spatiotemporal dynamics of a trapped bosonic condensate of exciton-polaritons. Both second- and first-order correlation functions are found to exhibit pronounced oscillations in time governed by the dynamics of the polariton condensate in the trap. We have identified the intermittent regime of stochastic transitions between stationary and limit-cycle regimes near the Andronov-Hopf bifurcation manifested in asymmetric distortions of the correlation function. This rich interplay of deterministic and stochastic condensate dynamics is explained theoretically as a manifestation of mutually compensating self-repulsion and reservoir-mediated attraction.

AI.tldr: 本文利用时间分辨率为80皮秒的超导单光子探测器，研究俘获的激子-极化激元玻色凝聚体的时空动力学。发现二阶和一阶相关函数均表现出由凝聚体在陷阱中动力学控制的显著时间振荡，并识别出安德罗诺夫-霍普夫分岔附近静止态与极限环态之间随机转变的间歇性 regime，表现为相关函数的不对称畸变。理论上将其解释为自排斥与储层介导吸引相互补偿的体现。
AI.motivation: 研究激子-极化激元玻色凝聚体在陷阱中的时空动力学，特别是确定性动力学与随机涨落之间的复杂相互作用，揭示接近安德罗诺夫-霍普夫分岔时的间歇性转变行为。
AI.method: 使用时间分辨率为80 ps的超导单光子探测器测量激子-极化激元凝聚体的光子关联，分析一阶和二阶相关函数的时间振荡，并结合理论模型解释动力学行为。
AI.result: 观察到相关函数呈现显著的时间振荡；识别出静止态和极限环态之间的随机间歇转变；发现相关函数出现不对称畸变，归因于自排斥与储层介导吸引的相互补偿机制。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了确定性非线性动力学与随机涨落共同塑造极化激元凝聚体的复杂时空行为，为理解分岔附近的临界动力学提供了实验证据和理论框架。

title: Anharmonic dephasing in the electron-phonon interaction
summary: Electron-phonon coupling has been a central topic in condensed matter physics for decades, and firstprinciples methods have demonstrated remarkable success in quantitatively capturing its role in a wide variety of physical phenomena and materials. Conventional calculations of electron-phonon coupling typically assume that phonons have infinite lifetimes, but phonons can exhibit finite lifetimes due to anharmonic phonon-phonon interactions. In this work, we derive an expression for the electron-phonon coupling scattering rates including the effects of anharmonic three-phonon interactions, which lead to phonon dephasing and finite phonon lifetimes. We also describe a first-principles implementation of this anharmonic electron-phonon coupling which can be seamlessly integrated within existing workflows for the evaluation of electron-phonon and phonon-phonon coupling interactions. Finally, we present calculations of electron-phonon scattering rates including phonon dephasing in a range of materials, and discuss the different microscopic mechanisms by which anharmonic phonons influence electron-phonon coupling. This study establishes the importance of finite phonon lifetimes in the evaluation of electron-phonon coupling, and provides a platform to explore these effects in a wide range of materials and phenomena.

AI.tldr: 本文推导了包含非谐三声子相互作用（导致声子退相和有限声子寿命）的电子-声子耦合散射率表达式，并实现了与现有工作流无缝集成的第一性原理计算方法，在多种材料中展示了声子退相对电子-声子散射率的影响。
AI.motivation: 传统电子-声子耦合计算假设声子具有无限寿命，但实际声子因非谐声子-声子相互作用具有有限寿命，这一因素被忽略可能导致对电子-声子耦合的定量描述不准确。
AI.method: 推导了包含非谐三声子相互作用的电子-声子耦合散射率解析表达式，并开发了第一性原理数值实现，该实现可无缝集成到现有的电子-声子与声子-声子耦合计算工作流中。
AI.result: 在多种材料中计算了包含声子退相的电子-声子散射率，并讨论了非谐声子影响电子-声子耦合的不同微观机制。
AI.conclusion: 该研究确立了有限声子寿命在电子-声子耦合评估中的重要性，并提供了一个可在广泛材料和现象中探索这些效应的计算平台。

title: Exchange-induced suppression of superconductivity in a nano-skyrmion lattice - superconductor hybrid
summary: Engineered magnet-superconductor hybrids have recently been identified as promising platforms for the investigation of topological superconductivity. Beyond ferro- and antiferromagnetic structures, coupling non-collinear spin textures, such as skyrmion lattices, to superconductors offers an exciting route for creating and manipulating unconventional superconducting states. In this work, by preparing monolayer Fe on Ir(111) thin films grown epitaxially on a Nb(110) surface, we realize a hybrid system of a nano-skyrmion lattice proximitized to a superconducting substrate. Scanning tunneling spectroscopy shows that superconductivity becomes suppressed by the Fe nano-skyrmion lattice, with both the superconducting gap and coherence peaks disappearing. Tight-binding calculations reveal that with increasing exchange coupling, the gap is progressively filled up and eventually superconductivity gets quenched. These results reveal microscopic constraints for designing topologically non-trivial states based on magnet-superconducting heterostructures.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过在Nb(110)表面外延生长单层Fe/Ir(111)薄膜，实现了纳米磁斯格明子晶格与超导衬底近邻耦合的混合系统。扫描隧道谱显示Fe纳米斯格明子晶格抑制了超导性，超导能隙和相干峰消失；紧束缚计算表明随交换耦合增强，能隙逐步被填充并最终淬灭超导性。
AI.motivation: 磁性-超导混合系统是研究拓扑超导性的有前景平台，但以往研究多集中于铁磁/反铁磁结构。将非共线自旋织构（如斯格明子晶格）与超导体耦合，为创建和操控非常规超导态提供了新途径，但这一方向尚缺乏实验验证，需要揭示其微观机制。
AI.method: 实验上，在Nb(110)表面外延生长单层Fe/Ir(111)薄膜，构建纳米斯格明子晶格与超导衬底的近邻耦合混合系统；利用扫描隧道谱（STS）表征超导性质变化。理论上，采用紧束缚计算模拟不同交换耦合强度下超导能隙的演化行为。
AI.result: 扫描隧道谱显示超导性被Fe纳米斯格明子晶格抑制，超导能隙和相干峰均消失；紧束缚计算表明随交换耦合增强，超导能隙被逐步填充，最终超导性完全淬灭。
AI.conclusion: 该工作揭示了基于磁性-超导异质结构设计拓扑非平凡态所需的微观约束条件，表明斯格明子晶格对超导的近邻效应会显著抑制超导性，为未来在磁超导混合系统中实现和调控拓扑超导态提供了重要的指导。

title: Bayesian Localization and Uncertainty Quantification of Trace Species in Two-Dimensional SIMS Imaging
summary: To enable accurate localization of trace species on material surfaces, we propose a Bayesian framework for analyzing two-dimensional (2D) secondary ion mass spectrometry (SIMS) imaging data. SIMS is widely used in semiconductor manufacturing, materials science, geology, environmental science, and life sciences because of its high sensitivity and excellent elemental and isotopic specificity. However, precise localization remains challenging because of primary ion beam broadening, overlap between neighboring ion distributions, and limited ion counts. The underlying distribution of trace species is modeled as a superposition of two-dimensional Gaussian peaks. To account for the stochastic nature of low-count measurements, the detected ion counts are assumed to follow a Poisson likelihood within a Bayesian framework. Posterior distributions of the peak parameters are estimated using replica-exchange Monte Carlo (REMC), enabling stable inference together with quantitative uncertainty estimation under low-count conditions. The proposed method is first validated using synthetic datasets with known ground truth and is then applied to SIMS measurements of semiconductor samples containing regularly arranged gold (Au) dots with diameters ranging from 0.4 to 2.0~$μ$m, using scanning electron microscopy (SEM) images as the reference. Optimization of the measurement conditions reduced the relative localization error for 0.4~$μ$m dots from 5.1$\%$ to 1.9$\%$. These results demonstrate accurate submicrometer localization with statistically rigorous uncertainty quantification in 2D SIMS imaging.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种贝叶斯框架，用于二维二次离子质谱（SIMS）成像中痕量物种的精确定位。该方法将痕量物种的潜在分布建模为二维高斯峰的叠加，采用泊松似然描述低计数测量的随机性，并通过副本交换蒙特卡洛（REMC）估计峰参数的后验分布。在半导体样品（金点直径0.4~2.0 μm）上的验证显示，通过优化测量条件，0.4 μm 点的相对定位误差从5.1%降至1.9%，实现了亚微米级精确定位和定量不确定性评估。
AI.motivation: SIMS成像虽然具有高灵敏度和优异的元素/同位素特异性，但在精确定位痕量物种方面面临三大挑战：一次离子束展宽、相邻离子分布重叠以及有限的离子计数。这些因素导致难以对材料表面的痕量物种进行准确的空间定位，因此需要一种能够处理低计数统计噪声并量化不确定性的新型分析框架。
AI.method: 该方法的核心包括：(1) 将痕量物种的潜在空间分布建模为多个二维高斯峰的叠加；(2) 假设检测到的离子计数服从泊松似然分布，以刻画低计数测量的随机性；(3) 在贝叶斯框架下，利用副本交换蒙特卡洛（REMC）方法估计峰参数的后验分布，实现稳定推断和定量不确定性估计。方法先通过已知真实值的合成数据集验证，再应用于含有规则排列金点（直径0.4~2.0 μm）的半导体SIMS测量，以SEM图像作为参考基准。
AI.result: 在合成数据上验证了方法的有效性；在实际半导体样品中，通过优化测量条件，0.4 μm 金点的相对定位误差从5.1%显著降低到1.9%。这表明该方法能够实现亚微米级精确定位，并同时提供统计上严格的不确定性量化。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的贝叶斯框架成功解决了2D SIMS成像中低计数条件下的痕量物种精确定位问题，证明了亚微米定位的准确性以及不确定性量化的统计严谨性，为SIMS在半导体制造等领域的精确定位应用提供了可靠工具。

title: Fermionic Lattice Supersolidity in the Attractive Three-Color Fermi-Hubbard Model
summary: The recent experimental realization of the half-filled three-color Fermi-Hubbard model on a square optical lattice provides a novel platform for exploring exotic states of matter beyond conventional SU(2) systems. In this Letter, we investigate the three-color Fermi-Hubbard model with color-dependent attractive interactions using determinant quantum Monte Carlo simulations. We find that, at quantum degenerate temperatures, a lattice Fermi supersolid state emerges from the interplay between a moderately-to-strongly interacting two-color subsystem and a weakly coupled third-color environment. This supersolid state, characterized by the coexistence of charge-density-wave and color-superfluid orders, is highly promising for experimental detection with current techniques. Our results demonstrate that the attractive three-color Fermi-Hubbard model on a square optical lattice offers an experimentally accessible system for exploring the supersolidity of ultracold lattice fermions, requiring only a simple lattice geometry and easily tunable onsite interactions.

AI.tldr: 本文通过行列式量子蒙特卡洛模拟研究方形光晶格上的三色费米-哈伯德模型，发现色依赖吸引相互作用下可在量子简并温度形成晶格费米超固态，该状态由两色子系统的强相互作用与第三色弱耦合环境共同驱动。
AI.motivation: 近期在方形光晶格上实验实现了半填充三色费米-哈伯德模型，为探索超越传统SU(2)系统的新奇物态提供了平台，但该模型中吸引相互作用下的新奇量子态尚未被充分研究。
AI.method: 采用行列式量子蒙特卡洛（determinant quantum Monte Carlo）模拟方法，研究具有色依赖吸引相互作用的三色费米-哈伯德模型。
AI.result: 在量子简并温度下，系统中出现晶格费米超固态，其特征是电荷密度波序与色超流序共存。该超固态由中等至强相互作用的两色子系统与弱耦合的第三色环境之间的相互作用所驱动。
AI.conclusion: 吸引性三色费米-哈伯德模型在方形光晶格上提供了一个实验上可实现的体系，用于探索超冷晶格费米子的超固态现象，且仅需简单的晶格几何构型和易调节的格点内相互作用即可实现，有望通过现有实验技术探测到。

title: Turning angle analysis reveals hidden anisotropies in the anomalous diffusion of molecules in live cells
comment: Main text: 17 pages, 6 figures; Supplementary information: 14 pages, 5 figures
summary: Molecular motion within living cells provides a window into the physical principles underlying intracellular organization and transport. Yet a fundamental limitation remains: measured trajectories are often short, noisy, and randomly oriented, rendering spatial anisotropies inaccessible to conventional analyses. We show that turning-angle statistics provide a robust approach for uncovering anisotropies in anomalous diffusion. Using a two-dimensional anisotropic fractional Brownian motion model with random orientations, we show theoretically and through simulations that turning-angle distributions preserve signatures of anisotropy. We apply this approach to single-particle tracking data, including quantum dots in the cytoplasm of HeLa cells and membrane proteins in hippocampal neurons. Turning angles reveal hidden anisotropies in the motion of quantum dots and Nav 1.6 channels, and in specific dynamical states of glycoprotein CD4. These results establish turning-angle analysis as a powerful strategy for detecting organization in complex environments and reveal that anisotropic anomalous diffusion is an overlooked feature of intracellular dynamics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出利用转向角统计来揭示活细胞内异常扩散中的空间各向异性。通过二维各向异性分数布朗运动模型，理论和模拟均证明转向角分布能保留各向异性特征，并将其应用于量子点和膜蛋白的单粒子追踪数据，发现细胞质和神经元中隐藏的各向异性运动。
AI.motivation: 活细胞内的分子运动轨迹通常短、含噪声且方向随机，传统分析方法无法探测空间各向异性。作者希望找到一种稳健的方法来揭示复杂细胞内环境中被忽视的各向异性异常扩散特征。
AI.method: 提出转向角（turning-angle）统计分析框架。使用二维各向异性分数布朗运动模型（方向随机），通过理论和仿真证明转向角分布可以保留各向异性特征；然后将该方法应用于单粒子追踪数据，包括HeLa细胞细胞质中的量子点以及海马神经元中的膜蛋白（Nav 1.6通道和CD4糖蛋白）。
AI.result: 转向角分析成功揭示了量子点和Nav 1.6通道运动中的隐藏各向异性，以及CD4糖蛋白特定动力学状态下的各向异性行为，证明了该方法在单粒子追踪数据中的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 转向角分析是一种强有力的策略，可用于检测复杂环境中的组织性，并揭示各向异性异常扩散是细胞内动力学中被忽视的重要特征。

title: Metastability limit of pristine 2D noble metals with high-energy facet: dominance of the Bell-Evans-Polanyi principle
summary: Using density functional theory, we predict that ultrathin (110) sheets of Rh, Pd, Ag, and Ir tend to transform into their (100) counterparts via lattice contraction. An approximately linear relationship between the transformation barrier and the energy difference between (110) and (100) sheets is revealed, demonstrating that the Bell-Evans-Polanyi (BEP) principle dominates. Furthermore, the critical thicknesses for these metals are also described by the BEP principle: below these thicknesses, the (110) sheets are no longer metastable and undergo spontaneous structural transformation.

AI.tldr: 利用密度泛函理论预测，Rh、Pd、Ag和Ir的超薄(110)片层会通过晶格收缩转变为(100)片层，且该转变遵循Bell-Evans-Polanyi（BEP）原理。
AI.motivation: 理解超薄金属纳米片的结构稳定性及其相变行为，特别是(110)与(100)晶面之间的结构转变机制。
AI.method: 采用密度泛函理论（DFT）进行计算模拟，分析(110)与(100)片层的能量差异、转变势垒，并建立转变势垒与能量差之间的线性关系来验证BEP原理，同时确定临界厚度。
AI.result: 发现(110)片层倾向于通过晶格收缩转变为(100)片层；转变势垒与(110)和(100)片层的能量差呈近似线性关系，符合BEP原理；BEP原理同样可用于描述临界厚度，低于该厚度时(110)片层不再亚稳定，会自发发生结构转变。
AI.conclusion: BEP原理是控制超薄金属片层结构转变的关键机制，可用于预测和描述薄金属膜的结构稳定性与临界厚度。

title: All-electrical Coherent Control of a Single Rare-earth Spin Qubit
summary: Electrical control of single spin qubits is a major frontier for nanoscale, high-speed, and scalable quantum devices. Yet, extending it to highly shielded rare-earth 4f electrons remains an experimental challenge across solid-state platforms. Here we demonstrate all-electrical coherent control of a single Er electron spin, which is exchange-coupled to a nearby Ti atom. Scanning tunneling microscopy-based electron spin resonance with three-dimensional magnetic-field control enables comprehensive mapping of the resonance and Rabi frequencies, revealing pronounced anisotropies in both the Er g-tensor and the Er-Ti exchange interaction. The electrical modulation of the anisotropic Er-Ti coupling results in an efficient drive of the Er spin, allowing us to achieve near-gigahertz Rabi frequencies - a ten-fold improvement over the present record for rare-earth spin qubits. By establishing anisotropic exchange as a general resource for electrically accessing shielded rare-earth spins, our results open a new route to ultrafast and local control of rare-earth spins in solid-state quantum devices.

AI.tldr: 该研究在扫描隧道显微镜平台上，通过三维磁场控制实现了单个铒（Er）电子自旋的全电学相干调控。利用Er与附近Ti原子之间的各向异性交换耦合，实现了近GHz的拉比频率，比现有稀土自旋量子比特纪录提升了十倍。
AI.motivation: 将电学控制扩展到高度屏蔽的稀土4f电子自旋是固态量子器件领域的一大挑战。传统稀土自旋由于4f电子被外层电子屏蔽，难以实现高效的电学操控，而电学控制对于纳米尺度、高速、可扩展的量子器件至关重要。
AI.method: 采用基于扫描隧道显微镜的电子自旋共振技术，结合三维磁场控制。单个Er电子自旋与附近的Ti原子通过交换相互作用耦合，通过电学调制各向异性的Er-Ti耦合来实现对Er自旋的高效驱动。系统绘制了共振频率和拉比频率的完整图谱，揭示了Er g张量和Er-Ti交换相互作用的显著各向异性。
AI.result: 成功实现了全电学相干控制单个Er电子自旋，实现了近GHz的拉比频率，比现有稀土自旋量子比特的纪录提高了十倍。
AI.conclusion: 建立了各向异性交换耦合作为电学访问屏蔽稀土自旋的通用资源，为固态量子器件中稀土自旋的超快和局域控制开辟了新途径。

title: Electronic conductivity in anharmonic crystals: Phonon dephasing in the electron-phonon interaction
summary: The electron-phonon interaction underpins many material properties, for example, the conductivity of metals and the optoelectronic response of semiconductors. First-principles calculations of the electron-phonon interaction are a powerful tool to quantitatively describe many of these properties in increasingly complex materials. However, one key assumption of all calculations is that phonons have infinite lifetimes, an approximation that may break down when anharmonic phonon-phonon interactions are strong. In this work, we present a theory for the interaction of electrons with finite-lifetime phonons experiencing dephasing. Using a first-principles implementation of the theory, we find that anharmonic dephasing dramatically enhances electron-phonon scattering rates in metallic MgB2. Microscopically, phonon-phonon interactions create new scattering channels that increase the phase space available for electron-phonon scattering. As a result, anharmonic dephasing strongly suppresses conductivity in MgB2, bringing the calculated values substantially closer to experiment within the Boltzmann transport equation framework. This example establishes the importance of finite phonon lifetimes in the evaluation of electron-phonon scattering, and the microscopic mechanism suggests that anharmonic dephasing could play an important role in the conductivity of many metals. More broadly, our theory and first-principles implementation of anharmonic dephasing in the electron-phonon interaction provides a solid foundation to explore this regime in other materials.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了电子与有限寿命声子（经历退相位的声子）相互作用的理论，并通过第一性原理实现发现，非谐退相位会显著增强金属MgB2中的电子-声子散射率，抑制电导率并使计算结果更接近实验值。
AI.motivation: 所有现有的电子-声子相互作用第一性原理计算都假设声子具有无限寿命，但在非谐声子-声子相互作用较强时该近似可能失效，从而影响电导率等性质的预测精度。
AI.method: 提出电子与有限寿命声子相互作用的理论框架，并通过第一性原理实现；以MgB2为测试体系，在玻尔兹曼输运方程框架下计算电子-声子散射率和电导率。
AI.result: 非谐退相位大幅增强MgB2中的电子-声子散射率，显著抑制电导率，使计算值与实验值更加接近。微观机制是声子-声子相互作用创造了新的散射通道，扩大了电子-声子散射的相空间。
AI.conclusion: 证明了有限声子寿命在评估电子-声子散射中的重要性，并提出非谐退相位可能在许多金属的电导率中发挥重要作用，为在其他材料中探索该机制提供了理论基础和实现工具。

title: Revealing Hidden Unconventional Pairing through Nonreciprocal Transport
summary: Identifying the pairing symmetry of Cooper pairs is a fundamental step toward understanding the microscopic mechanisms of unconventional superconductors. However, experimental identification remains a formidable challenge, particularly when unconventional pairing is obscured by a dominant $s$-wave component that masks its spectroscopic signatures. Here, we develop a symmetry-resolved framework to identify superconducting pairing symmetry through nonreciprocal conductance upon exchanging source and detector terminals in multiterminal devices. We show that nonreciprocal transport arises from symmetry-breaking components of the superconducting order parameter and exhibits a characteristic angular dependence that encodes the momentum-space structure of the pairing gap. In particular, time-reversal-breaking singlet pairing induces nonreciprocal charge transport, while spin-triplet pairing generates nonreciprocal spin responses, providing distinct transport fingerprints of the underlying order. We demonstrate this mechanism using representative models of iron-based and noncentrosymmetric superconductors and outline experimental protocols for multiterminal measurements. Our results advance the theoretical understanding of nonreciprocal transport in superconductors, and establish it as a symmetry-selective probe for identifying hidden unconventional pairing in a wide range of superconducting materials.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于多终端器件中非互易电导的对称性分辨框架，用于识别超导体的配对对称性，特别是当非常规配对被主导的s波分量掩盖时。该方法通过交换源端和探测端来探测非互易输运，其角度依赖性编码了配对能隙的动量空间结构，可区分时间反演破缺的单态配对（产生非互易电荷输运）和自旋三重态配对（产生非互易自旋响应）。
AI.motivation: 识别Cooper对的配对对称性是理解非常规超导体微观机制的基础，但实验识别极具挑战，尤其当非常规配对被占主导的s波分量掩盖而难以通过光谱特征区分时，需要一种能够特异性识别隐藏配对对称性的实验探针。
AI.method: 作者发展了一个对称性分辨的理论框架，利用多终端器件中交换源端和探测端位置时产生的非互易电导来探测超导配对对称性。该方法基于非互易输运源于序参量的对称性破缺分量这一物理机制，并分析了其角度依赖性与配对能隙动量空间结构的对应关系。
AI.result: 研究表明：时间反演破缺的单态配对会诱导非互易电荷输运，而自旋三重态配对则产生非互易自旋响应，两者提供了不同的输运指纹。作者通过铁基超导体和非中心对称超导体的代表性模型验证了这一机制，并提出了多终端测量的实验方案。
AI.conclusion: 该工作推进了对超导体中非互易输运的理论理解，确立了非互易输运作为一种对称性选择性探针，可用于识别广泛超导材料中隐藏的非常规配对，为实验上克服s波主导掩盖效应的难题提供了新途径。

title: Analytical Nuclear Gradients and Hessians on Quantum Hardware via Orbital-Optimized VQE with Error Mitigation
summary:
Nuclear gradients and Hessians are fundamental quantities in computational chemistry, essential for a wide range of applications including geometry optimization, vibrational spectroscopy, and molecular property calculations. In this work, we present their analytical implementation on quantum hardware. The methodology is formulated within an active-space framework combining orbital optimization and linear-response theory.
  On the quantum-computing side, the approach employs the tiled unitary product state (tUPS) ansatz to directly evaluate the tensor elements required for solving the response equations. Moreover, the expectation values are corrected using an adapted confusion-matrix error-mitigation scheme in combination with post-selection criteria. The resulting workflow is assessed on molecular hydrogen and on water through the calculation of potential energy surfaces, nuclear gradients, Hessians, and vibrational frequencies, enabling the evaluation of both its capabilities and current limitations.
  The results demonstrate good performance for the hydrogen molecule, whereas the water molecule provides a more demanding test of quantum-hardware resources and highlights the trade-offs associated with error-mitigation strategies. The quantified analysis of the results identify the main sources of errors, suggesting improvement directions for more accurate quantum computer applications.

AI.tldr: 本文在量子硬件上实现了核梯度和Hessian的解析计算，采用活动空间框架结合轨道优化和线性响应理论，使用tiled unitary product state (tUPS) 拟设直接评估响应方程所需的张量元素，并通过适应性混淆矩阵纠错方案和后选择准则修正期望值。工作流在氢分子和水分子上通过计算势能面、核梯度、Hessian和振动频率进行了评估，结果显示氢分子性能良好，而水分子更具挑战性，突出了纠错策略的权衡。
AI.motivation: 核梯度和Hessian是计算化学中的基础量，广泛应用于几何优化、振动光谱和分子性质计算，但目前在量子硬件上的解析实现仍然缺失或具有挑战性，因此需要开发适用于量子计算机的解析实现方法。
