AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种多任务扫描探针显微镜（Multitask SPM）工作流程，通过多任务高斯过程实时学习空间与跨模态关系，自主选择下一个测量位置和实验协议，在自动化大样品原子力显微镜上实现，并在AlScN组分梯度晶圆上通过轻敲模式和DART测量进行了验证。
AI.motivation: 扫描探针显微镜在晶圆级表征和组合材料探索中的广泛应用，需要在大型空间域上高效分配测量。不同模态的采集时间和对针尖/样品的损伤潜力差异显著，使得穷尽式多模态空间网格测绘不切实际，因此需要智能化的主动测量分配策略。
AI.method: 采用多任务高斯过程作为核心算法，在实时闭环工作流中同时学习空间相关性和跨模态相关性。系统通过成对初始测量建立任务间关系，此后利用非重合测量点同时更新两个响应图。算法自主决策下一个测量位置和下一个实验协议（模态选择）。在自动化大样品AFM上实现，使用轻敲模式和DART两种模态。
AI.result: 在AlScN组分梯度晶圆上成功验证了该工作流，通过轻敲模式与DART测量的结合，实现了任务间关系的建立以及非重合测量点对双响应图的同时更新。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将扫描探针显微镜中的主动学习从单纯的空间采样扩展到了测量模态的自主分配，为快速、弱扰动成像与较慢接触式、电学、机电、磁性或光谱测量的组合提供了基础。

title: Buried germanium quantum well proximitised by magnetic field-resilient superconducting platinum iridium germanosilicide
summary: Hybrid superconductor-semiconductor systems provide a versatile platform for quantum technologies, ranging from superconducting-spin interfaces to topological quantum devices. Progress toward scalable implementations requires superconductors that exhibit high critical fields ($>1$T) at accessible temperatures integrated with low-disorder semiconductor heterostructures. Here we demonstrate a superconducting platinum iridium germanosilicide (PtIrSiGe), with critical out-of-plane magnetic field up to $B_{\perp} = 1.9$T and critical temperature of $T_c\sim 1.85$K, integrated with planar germanium with mobility $μ= 1.3\times 10^6$cm$^{2}$/Vs via top-down lithography fabrication. We show that the integrity of the germanium quantum well and mobility and density of the 2D hole gas are preserved despite annealing at $500°$C, a temperature comparable to that used for strained germanium epitaxy. We further demonstrate proximitisation of a buried germanium quantum well in a gate-defined Josephson junction/SQUID on a Ge/SiGe heterostructure.

AI.tldr: 本文展示了一种新型超导材料铂铱锗硅化物（PtIrSiGe），具有高达1.9T的临界磁场和约1.85K的临界温度，并通过自上而下的光刻工艺与高迁移率（1.3×10⁶ cm²/Vs）的平面锗集成。研究证明在500°C退火后锗量子阱的完整性和二维空穴气的迁移率及密度得以保持，并在Ge/SiGe异质结构上的栅控约瑟夫森结/SQUID中实现了埋层锗量子阱的近邻化效应。
AI.motivation: 混合超导体-半导体系统是量子技术（如超导-自旋界面和拓扑量子器件）的通用平台，但实现可扩展应用需要兼具高临界磁场（>1T）和可及工作温度的高质量超导体，且需与低无序半导体异质结构集成。现有材料尚不能满足这些条件。
AI.method: 采用铂铱锗硅化物（PtIrSiGe）作为超导材料，通过自上而下的光刻制造工艺将其集成到平面锗（Ge）上。对集成样品进行500°C高温退火处理（与应变锗外延温度相当），并表征锗量子阱的完整性、二维空穴气的迁移率和密度。进一步在Ge/SiGe异质结构上构建栅控约瑟夫森结/SQUID器件，验证埋层锗量子阱的近邻化效应。
AI.result: PtIrSiGe的临界面外磁场高达1.9T，临界温度约1.85K；与锗集成后锗的迁移率达到1.3×10⁶ cm²/Vs；500°C退火后锗量子阱的完整性和二维空穴气性质得到保持；在Ge/SiGe异质结构上成功演示了埋层锗量子阱的栅控约瑟夫森结/SQUID近邻化。
AI.conclusion: PtIrSiGe是一种满足高临界磁场需求的可行超导材料，能够与高迁移率锗半导体以可扩展的自上而下工艺集成，且能承受与锗外延兼容的高温处理，为超导-半导体混合量子平台提供了新的材料解决方案。

title: All-Electron Single-Atom Reference Correction for Absolute Transition Energies in Fixed-Reference PAW-XCH Calculations
summary: The transition energy of a core-loss spectrum comprises a transferable atomic core-reference contribution and a material-dependent response that determines chemical shifts. Density functional theory calculations commonly underestimate absolute transition energies. In VASP, the same PAW dataset is used for the ground and core-excited occupations, retaining the ground-state atomic reference when the core occupation changes and thereby omitting the associated all-electron atomic reference change. We evaluate this change using self-consistent single-atom calculations and construct a residual atomic reference correction from the valence reference change and isolated-atom total-energy response. Comparisons with an independent ultrasoft-pseudopotential implementation demonstrate numerical consistency of the all-electron reference for K, L1, and L2,3 core holes, while representative corrected spectra approach the experimental absolute energy scale. For a fixed element, edge, and core-hole scheme, the atomic reference terms cancel from energy differences, showing that same-element chemical shifts are governed by the double difference of the supercell total energy. At the Al and Si L2,3 edges, the near-edge spectral shape additionally depends strongly on the PAW representation of low-lying 3d-like unoccupied states.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了VASP中DFT计算芯损失谱绝对跃迁能时的原子芯参考修正问题。研究发现PAW数据集在基态和芯激发态使用相同参考态，忽略了芯占据变化时伴随的全电子原子参考变化。作者通过自洽单原子计算评估了此变化，构建了残余原子参考修正，使修正后的光谱接近实验绝对值，并证明同元素化学位移由超胞总能的双重差分决定。
AI.motivation: DFT计算通常会低估芯损失谱的绝对跃迁能量。在VASP中，基态和芯激发态使用相同的PAW数据集，当芯占据数改变时保留了基态原子参考，从而遗漏了相关的全电子原子参考变化，导致绝对跃迁能计算不准确。作者希望修正这一问题，使计算光谱接近实验绝对能量标度。
AI.method: 通过自洽单原子计算评估芯占据变化引起的全电子原子参考变化，从价带参考变化和孤立原子总能响应构建残余原子参考修正。将修正结果与独立的超软赝势实现进行数值比较，验证K、L1、L2,3芯孔的全电子参考一致性。并考察PAW表示对低能3d类未占据态对近边谱形的影响。
AI.result: 与超软赝势实现的比较证实了K、L1、L2,3芯孔的全电子参考数值一致性，修正后的光谱接近实验绝对能量标度。对于固定元素、边和芯孔方案，原子参考项在能量差中抵消，同元素化学位移由超胞总能的双重差分决定。在Al和Si的L2,3边，近边谱形强烈依赖于PAW对低能3d类未占据态的表示。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了VASP中芯损失谱绝对跃迁能的系统修正方案，明确了同元素化学位移的物理本质（超胞总能双重差分），并揭示PAW表示对近边谱形的重要影响，为准确计算X射线吸收谱提供了指导。

title: Symmetry Breaking by Interfacial Dead Layers: Observation of Forbidden Self-Induced Spin-Orbit Torque in Symmetric Ferromagnets
summary: Conventionally, spin-orbit torques (SOTs) in ferromagnets require heavy-metal layers or engineered structural asymmetry to break inversion symmetry. In this work, we report the observation of robust, self-generated SOTs in a nominally symmetric, heavy-metal-free MgO/NiFe/MgO trilayer - a geometry where such torques are theoretically forbidden. By combining harmonic Hall measurements with SQUID magnetometry and X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy, we identify the symmetry-breaking origin: a 1.8 nm magnetic dead layer at the bottom interface. Crucially, we demonstrate a quantitative agreement between our data and the drift-diffusion theory predicted by Kim and Lee, yielding a theoretically extracted dead-layer thickness (1.2 nm) which matches structural characterization. Furthermore, density-functional calculations confirm that NiFe possesses sufficient intrinsic spin Hall conductivity to support the observed spin currents. These results reframe the parasitic dead layer as a functional spintronic component, establishing a universal, all-ferromagnetic route to SOTs in standard magnetic heterostructures.

AI.tldr: 本文报道了在对称的、无重金属的MgO/NiFe/MgO三层结构中观测到自生自旋轨道矩(SOTs)，并确定其来源于底部界面1.8 nm磁死层破坏了对称性，实验结果与Kim和Lee的漂移-扩散理论定量吻合。
AI.motivation: 传统上SOTs需依赖重金属层或结构非对称来打破反演对称性，而该工作挑战了这一范式，旨在探索在标称对称的全铁磁异质结构中产生SOTs的可能性，并揭示其微观机制。
AI.method: 结合谐波霍尔测量、SQUID磁强计和X射线光电子能谱表征界面结构，通过密度泛函理论计算NiFe的内在自旋霍尔电导率，并与Kim和Lee的漂移-扩散理论模型进行定量比较。
AI.result: 在无重金属的对称MgO/NiFe/MgO三层结构中观测到鲁棒的自生SOTs；识别出1.8 nm磁死层为对称性破缺来源；实验提取的死层厚度(1.2 nm)与结构表征吻合；DFT证实NiFe具有足够的本征自旋霍尔电导率。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将寄生性磁死层重新定义为功能性自旋电子学组件，建立了一条在全铁磁标准磁性异质结构中产生SOTs的普适途径。

title: Machine-learning octet $AB$-type binary compounds across chemical space with domain knowledge of the interatomic bond
summary: The prediction of the structural stability of octet $AB$-type binary compounds is a classical materials informatics problem. The challenge is to capture the relative stability of 4-fold coordinated atoms in zincblende ($β$-ZnS) structure and 6-fold coordinated atoms in rocksalt (NaCl) structure, modulated by charge transfer and atomic-size differences. Previous structure maps and machine-learning approaches used atomic features such as valence-electron count, ionization potential and atomic radii, using either physical intuition or symbolic regression. Here, we demonstrate that explicitly incorporating the domain knowledge of the interatomic bonds can significantly and systematically improve the prediction of $β$-ZnS/NaCl stability. We encode this bonding information through a coarse-grained representation of the local electronic structure obtained by a recursive solution of a tight-binding bond model. The underlying pairwise Hamiltonians are taken from downfolded eigenstates of density-functional theory calculations for diatomic molecules and thereby include domain knowledge of the bond between specific $A-B$ pairs. The benefit of this description is demonstrated with an ensemble of independently trained Kernel Ridge or symbolic regression models combined with sequential feature selection. The obtained models are compared to a previous symbolic-regression model using the same set of \emph{ab initio} calculations for octet binaries as training data. We find a significant improvement in the prediction of the formation energy difference of $AB$ compounds as compared to previous works and demonstrate that an increasing amount of bond-informed recursion features improves the predictive accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种将键合领域知识显式融入机器学习模型的方法，通过紧束缚键模型的递归求解获得粗粒化的局域电子结构表示，用于预测八电子AB型二元化合物的β-ZnS/NaCl结构稳定性，相比以往方法显著提高了形成能差的预测精度。
AI.motivation: 八电子AB型二元化合物的结构稳定性预测是经典的材料信息学问题。以往的结构图和机器学习方法主要依赖原子层面的特征（如价电子数、电离势、原子半径），但未能充分捕捉原子间成键信息，导致对4配位（闪锌矿）和6配位（岩盐）结构相对稳定性的预测精度有限。
AI.method: 将原子间成键的领域知识通过紧束缚键模型的递归求解进行粗粒化编码，得到局域电子结构的表示。底层成对哈密顿量来自双原子分子DFT计算的降维本征态，包含特定A-B对的成键知识。使用核岭回归或符号回归模型的集成，结合序贯特征选择进行训练。
AI.result: 相比以往使用相同ab initio训练数据的符号回归模型，该方法在AB化合物形成能差的预测上取得了显著改进，并且证明增加键信息递归特征的数量能够持续提升预测精度。
AI.conclusion: 显式纳入原子间成键领域知识可以系统性地改善结构稳定性预测模型的性能，为材料信息学中特征工程提供了新的方向。

title: Time-resolved study of carbonization and growth of ultrathin 3C-SiC on Si(111) under ultra-high vacuum
summary: The early-stage formation of silicon carbide (SiC) on Si(111) by ethylene exposure under ultra-high vacuum (UHV) was investigated to resolve the time-dependent chemical and morphological evolution of an ultrathin layer. Clean Si(111) substrates were exposed to C$_2$H$_4$ at 800 °C for 2 min to 4 h, and the surfaces followed by in-situ X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS) and ex-situ AFM, SEM, AES, SIMS and TEM. Si 2p and C 1s peak analysis shows the progressive conversion of elemental silicon into a carbidic Si-C phase, the SiC fraction overtaking the elemental component between 120 and 160 min and saturating near 80-81% beyond 180 min, leaving about 19-20% residual elemental silicon. Correlative SEM and AFM reveal a parallel morphological progression, from sparse isolated islands to a coalesced, near-continuous layer. AES depth profiling confirms carbon incorporated into the near-surface region rather than weakly adsorbed as contamination, assigning the islands to early SiC nuclei. TEM confirms the zinc-blende lattice and the presence of cubic silicon carbide (3C-SiC). Together, these results provide a time-resolved picture of SiC nucleation, coalescence and layer growth on Si(111), relevant to 3C-SiC heteroepitaxy, and can be utilized in the optimization of SiC/Si(111) templates for growth of III-nitride and other carbide systems on silicon (e.g. Mo$_2$C).

AI.tldr: 本研究通过XPS、AFM、SEM、AES、SIMS和TEM等多种表征手段，系统研究了Si(111)表面在UHV条件下经乙烯暴露形成超薄SiC层的时序演化过程（2分钟至4小时），揭示了从稀疏孤立岛状核到连续层的形貌演变，以及SiC组分在120-160分钟内超过元素硅并最终饱和于80-81%的化学演化过程。
AI.motivation: 理解SiC在Si(111)上的早期成核与生长机制（时间分辨的化学与形貌演化），以优化3C-SiC/Si(111)模板，用于Si上生长III族氮化物及其他碳化物（如Mo2C）外延。
AI.method: 在UHV条件下于800°C将清洁Si(111)衬底暴露于C2H4（2分钟至4小时），采用原位XPS追踪Si 2p和C 1s峰的化学状态变化，结合离位AFM、SEM、AES、SIMS和TEM表征形貌、成分深度分布及晶体结构。
AI.result: Si 2p和C 1s分析显示元素硅逐步转化为碳化Si-C相；SiC组分在120-160分钟间超过元素组分，180分钟后饱和于80-81%，残留约19-20%元素硅。SEM/AFM显示形貌从稀疏孤立岛演变为合并的近连续层。AES深度剖析确认碳嵌入近表面区域（非弱吸附污染），岛状结构为早期SiC核。TEM证实纤锌矿晶格及立方碳化硅(3C-SiC)的存在。
AI.conclusion: 研究提供了SiC在Si(111)上成核、合并与层生长的时序图像，对3C-SiC异质外延及SiC/Si(111)模板优化具有直接参考价值。

title: A spin-bond theory unifying non-relativistic spin splitting and emergent spin-orbit textures
summary: Magnetic order with vanishing net magnetization can produce non-relativistic spin-split bands, broadly categorized into even-parity altermagnets and odd-parity \(p\)-wave magnets. Here, we introduce a spin-bond theory that unifies these seemingly distinct phenomena into a single algebraic framework. We demonstrate that non-relativistic spin textures are fundamentally governed by two components of the electronic bond: unitary spin phases and Hermitian spin amplitudes. The unitary sector generates odd-parity p-wave and emergent spin-orbit-like textures, while the Hermitian sector generates even-parity spin fields, including the uniform \(Γ\)-split and bond-structured altermagnetic limits. Beyond unifying known phases, our theory uncovers a mixed non-commuting regime that emerges when the unitary and Hermitian sectors fail to commute, revealing an underlying non-commuting spin-bond structure. This regime generates a non-coplanar spin texture characterized by an even-in-momentum transverse spin polarization, providing a direct spectroscopic fingerprint for spin- and angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy. Furthermore, we establish that this synthetic spin-orbit coupling can be dynamically tuned by geometrically controlling the non-commutation of the bond sectors. By providing a microscopic foundation for such tuning, our theory paves the way for advanced applications, including field-free spin qubits.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种自旋键理论（spin-bond theory），将交变磁体（altermagnets）和p波磁体统一到一个代数框架中，揭示了非相对论自旋纹理由电子键的两个分量（酉自旋相位和厄米自旋振幅）共同调控，并发现了酉与厄米扇区不交换时产生的混合非对易区，可产生非共面自旋纹理及可直接通过自旋-角度分辨光电子能谱观测的指纹特征。
AI.motivation: 传统认为具有零净磁化强度的磁有序可以产生非相对论自旋劈裂带，但这些现象（偶宇称交变磁体与奇宇称p波磁体）看似截然不同，缺乏统一的代数框架来理解其内在联系与共同起源。
AI.method: 引入自旋键理论，将电子键分解为酉自旋相位（unitary spin phases）和厄米自旋振幅（Hermitian spin amplitudes）两个分量。酉扇区产生奇宇称p波和类似自旋-轨道耦合的纹理，厄米扇区产生偶宇称自旋场（包括均匀Γ劈裂和键结构交变磁体极限）。当两扇区不对易时，揭示混合非对易区及其非共面自旋纹理结构。
AI.result: 该理论统一了交变磁体与p波磁体，发现了由非对易自旋键结构产生的非共面自旋纹理，其具有动量方向上的偶对称横向自旋极化，可作为自旋和角度分辨光电子能谱的直接光谱指纹。此外，合成自旋-轨道耦合可通过几何控制键扇区的非对易性实现动态调控。
AI.conclusion: 该自旋键理论不仅统一了已知的自旋劈裂相，更为无场自旋量子比特等先进应用提供了微观基础，展示了通过几何调控实现合成自旋-轨道耦合动态可调的前景。

title: Preserved metallicity and tunable magnetism in Zr-based Janus MXenes
comment: 9 pages, Physical Chemistry Chemical Physics (2026). Published by the Royal Society of Chemistry. DOI: 10.1039/d6cp00440g
summary: Janus MXenes provide a chemically asymmetric platform to tailor the properties of two-dimensional transition metal carbides. Here, we present a systematic first-principles study of the structural, electronic, mechanical, and magnetic properties of Janus ZrMCX2 MXenes (M = Cr, Hf, Nb, Sc, Ti; X = F, Cl, S). All compositions exhibit negative formation energies and satisfy the Born stability criteria, supporting the energetic and mechanical stability of the Janus structures. In contrast to the metal-tosemiconductor transitions frequently reported for functionalized MXenes, we find that the metallic character is preserved in nearly all ZrMCX2 systems, despite the strong chemical asymmetry introduced by the Janus configuration. Surface functionalization nevertheless plays a key role in modulating the electronic density near the Fermi level and strongly influences the magnetic and mechanical responses. Several compounds exhibit ferromagnetic or antiferromagnetic ground states, three display halfmetallicity, and sizable magnetic anisotropy energies are obtained, with Neel temperatures exceeding room temperature in selected cases. Functionalization also enhances the elastic stiffness of the Janus structures. These results demonstrate that chemical asymmetry and surface termination provide effective control over magnetic and mechanical properties while maintaining a robust metallic framework, identifying Zr-based Janus MXenes as promising model systems for metallic and spindependent two-dimensional materials.

AI.tldr: 本文通过第一性原理系统研究了Janus ZrMCX2 MXenes（M = Cr, Hf, Nb, Sc, Ti; X = F, Cl, S）的结构、电子、力学和磁学性质。所有组分均具有负形成能并满足Born稳定性准则，且几乎所有体系都保持金属性（与常见报道的金属-半导体转变不同）。表面官能化显著调控费米能级附近的电子密度，并强烈影响磁性和力学响应。多个化合物表现出铁磁或反铁磁基态，三种显示半金属性，部分体系的Néel温度超过室温。官能化还增强了弹性刚度，表明Zr基Janus MXenes是金属性和自旋相关二维材料的有前景模型体系。
AI.motivation: Janus MXenes因其化学不对称性为调控二维过渡金属碳化物性质提供了独特平台，但对其结构、电子、力学和磁学性质缺乏系统认识。
AI.method: 采用第一性原理计算，对Janus ZrMCX2 MXenes（不同过渡金属M和表面官能团X组合）进行系统研究，评估其结构稳定性（形成能、Born准则）、电子结构、力学性能和磁学性质。
AI.result: 所有组分均稳定；几乎所有体系保持金属性；多个体系具有铁磁/反铁磁基态，三种显示半金属性，部分Néel温度超过室温；官能化增强弹性刚度并获得可观磁各向异性能。
AI.conclusion: 化学不对称性和表面终止基团可有效调控磁性和力学性能，同时保持稳健的金属框架，Zr基Janus MXenes是金属性和自旋相关二维材料的有前景平台。

title: Predictive Simulation of Interphases on Li Metal Surface
summary: Interphases remain the least understood components in advanced batteries. Although their properties dictate whether a new battery chemistry could perform as designed, there has never been a reliable way to predict what an interphase could arise from a new electrolyte system due to the absence of atomistic level knowledge about interphasial formation process. In this work, we attempt to develop a simulation method that can universally predict interphasial chemistries formed on Li metal surface, so that the electrolyte engineering would no longer need lengthy Edisonian approaches. By combining a transferable universal polarizable force field and a universal machine learning force field, we simulate interphasial chemistry across chemically diverse electrolyte formulations, and successfully replicate the experimental observation that fluorinated solvents promote the formation of LiF-rich interphases, whereas interphases of more organic origin arise from conventional carbonate-based electrolytes. By directly capturing these spontaneous interfacial reactions behind these interphasial chemistries, our simulations establish molecular-level relationships between electrolyte chemistry, salt concentration, decomposition pathways, and SEI properties, and opens a route toward universal and high-throughput predictive simulation of interphases that is the foundation for AI-driven electrolyte discoveries.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种结合通用极化力场与通用机器学习力场的模拟方法，能够普遍预测锂金属表面形成的界面化学（SEI），从而加速电解质工程从试错法向AI驱动的预测性设计转变。
AI.motivation: 界面相（Interphases）是先进电池中最不为人知的部分，其性质决定新电池化学能否按设计运行。然而由于缺乏对界面形成过程的原子级认识，从来没有可靠方法预测新电解质体系会产生何种界面相，导致电解质工程依赖漫长的试错（Edisonian）方法。
AI.method: 将可迁移的通用极化力场与通用机器学习力场相结合，在化学组成多样化的电解质配方上模拟界面化学，直接捕捉界面形成背后的自发界面反应。
AI.result: 成功复现了实验观察：氟化溶剂促进LiF富集界面相的形成，而传统碳酸酯类电解质则产生更多有机来源的界面相。模拟建立了电解质化学、盐浓度、分解路径与SEI性质之间的分子级关联。
AI.conclusion: 该工作开辟了通用化、高通量预测性界面相模拟的路线，为AI驱动的电解质发现奠定基础。

title: Polar-vortex-driven interfacial strain coupling in PbTiO3/SrRuO3 Heterostructures
summary: Interfacial coupling in oxide heterostructures is a central problem in condensed-matter physics, as it typically emerges at the atomic scale through local interactions mediated by lattice polarization and strain. In this work, we investigate nanoscale polar-supertexture-driven interfacial strain coupling in (PbTiO3)16/(SrRuO3)9/(PbTiO3)16 heterostructures grown on DyScO3(110) substrates. Under appropriate epitaxial strain conditions, the PbTiO3 layers form polar vortex superstructures with a periodicity of approximately 10 nm. We demonstrate that the resulting in-plane nanoscale strain modulation propagates into the SrRuO3 layer. Using element-specific resonant X-ray reflectivity, we probe the nanoscale strain modulations of the strontium and ruthenium sublattices at the interface, revealing strong interfacial strain coupling between the ferroelectric and ferromagnetic layers. These findings provide new insights into engineering nanoscale magnetic modulations through interfacial strain and polarization control.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了(PbTiO3)16/(SrRuO3)9/(PbTiO3)16异质结中由纳米级极性超结构驱动的界面应变耦合，发现铁电层的极性涡旋超结构（周期约10 nm）产生的面内纳米应变调制能传播进入SrRuO3层，通过元素特异共振X射线反射率测量揭示了铁电层与铁磁层之间的强界面应变耦合。
AI.motivation: 氧化物异质结中的界面耦合是凝聚态物理的核心问题，通常在原子尺度通过晶格极化和应变的局域相互作用产生。理解纳米尺度的极性超结构驱动的界面应变耦合对于调控界面磁性具有重要意义。
AI.method: 在DyScO3(110)衬底上生长(PbTiO3)16/(SrRuO3)9/(PbTiO3)16异质结，利用极性涡旋超结构产生的面内纳米应变调制，并采用元素特异的共振X射线反射率技术探测界面处锶和钌亚晶格的纳米尺度应变调制。
AI.result: 在适当的外延应变条件下，PbTiO3层形成周期约10 nm的极性涡旋超结构，产生的面内纳米尺度应变调制传播进入SrRuO3层，在界面处观察到铁电层与铁磁层之间的强界面应变耦合。
AI.conclusion: 该发现为通过界面应变和极化控制来工程化纳米尺度磁性调制提供了新的见解和途径。

title: Spatially resolved elastic strain and lattice rotation at threading dislocations in HgCdTe/CdZnTe epilayers by dark-field X-ray microscopy
summary: Threading dislocations (TDs) propagating from a Cd$_{1-y}$Zn$_{y}$Te (CZT) substrate into a liquid-phase-epitaxy Hg$_{1-x}$Cd$_{x}$Te (MCT) epilayer set the minority-carrier lifetime and dark-current floor of mid-wave infrared focal-plane arrays, yet at device-grade densities their local strain fields have been accessible only through topography, which conflates lattice tilt and elastic strain. We apply dark-field X-ray microscopy in reflection geometry to a \SI{7}{\micro\metre}-thick (111) MCT/CZT epilayer. Shallow Bragg angle and absorption makes the signal layer dominated while the numerical aperture of the objective keeps the layer and substrate rocking curves convolved, so weak-beam images on either side of the rocking curve and their difference image the correlated defects in a single frame: dot-like substrate TDs and the elongated, in-plane island features they nucleate in the layer. Kernel average misorientation resolves each TD as a \SI{7}{\micro\metre} signature, the layer thickness, alongside axial strain lobes of $\pm(4$ to $5)\times10^{-5}$.

AI.tldr: 该论文采用反射几何暗场X射线显微镜（DFXM）对7微米厚的(111) MCT/CZT外延层进行成像，通过弱束成像策略在单帧中同时揭示衬底穿透位错（TDs）及其在外延层中诱发的岛状缺陷，并利用核平均取向差（KAM）解析出每个TD对应层厚的7微米特征信号及±(4-5)×10⁻⁵的轴向应变瓣。
AI.motivation: CZT衬底中的穿透位错进入MCT外延层后会限制少子寿命并决定中波红外焦平面阵列的暗电流下限，但器件级密度下这些位错的局部应变场以往只能通过形貌学方法获取，而形貌学方法混淆了晶格倾斜与弹性应变，需要发展能够区分两者的高分辨率表征手段。
AI.method: 采用反射几何暗场X射线显微镜（DFXM），借助浅布拉格角与吸收效应使信号主要来自外延层，同时利用物镜数值孔径保持层与衬底摇摆曲线卷积；在摇摆曲线两侧采集弱束图像并做差分，从而在单帧中同时成像衬底贯穿点状位错与层内拉长的面内岛状缺陷；最后用核平均取向差（KAM）解析应变分布。
AI.result: 成功在单帧中同时分辨出衬底点状穿透位错与外延层内拉长的面内岛状缺陷；KAM分析将每个穿透位错解析为7微米（等于层厚）的特征信号，并测得±(4到5)×10⁻⁵的轴向应变瓣。
AI.conclusion: 该方法可在器件级位错密度下实现对MCT/CZT外延层内穿透位错及其相关缺陷的应变场定量成像，有效区分晶格倾斜与弹性应变，为红外焦平面阵列材料缺陷表征提供了有力的无损三维X射线显微手段。

title: Substrate-dependent thermally driven morphological evolution of Pt$_{0.9}$Ni$_{0.1}$ thin films on sapphire and langasite
comment: 8 pages, 5 figures in the main manuscript; 4 pages, 5 figures in the Supplemental Material
summary: We examine the thermal evolution of 100-nm-thick Pt$_{0.9}$Ni$_{0.1}$ alloy films on sapphire and langasite substrates with a 10-nm Zr adhesion layer. Sequential vacuum annealing from room temperature to 800 $^\circ$C produces a substrate-dependent morphological pathway that is quantified by atomic force microscopy, image segmentation, height-distribution analysis, and effective coarsening metrics. Both types of films remain densely granular up to 400 $^\circ$C, undergo a sharp coarsening transition between 400 and 600 $^\circ$C, and evolve into coalesced faceted crystallites by 800 $^\circ$C. The mean projected feature area increases from $7.84 \times 10^2$ to $1.09 \times 10^5$ nm$^2$ on langasite and from $3.32 \times 10^2$ to $1.67 \times 10^5$ nm$^2$ on sapphire. Sapphire therefore develops the larger faceted crystallites, while langasite exhibits the larger roughness maximum at 600 $^\circ$C. Area distributions reveal that the 400-600 $^\circ$C transition does not uniformly shift the initial granular population but instead replaces it with a distinct large-feature ensemble. Height and roughness measurements show a pronounced maximum at 600 $^\circ$C, followed by partial smoothing at 800 $^\circ$C, consistent with rapid coalescence followed by faceting-limited growth. An effective Arrhenius analysis based on $Δ\langle r^2\rangle$, with $\langle r^2\rangle = \langle A\rangle/π$, identifies the 400-600 $^\circ$C interval as the dominant coarsening window. These results show that the thermal stability of PtNi/Zr films on sapphire and langasite is governed by the coupled influence of alloy mobility, interfacial energetics, and substrate-dependent morphological selection.

AI.tldr: 研究了100纳米厚Pt₀.₉Ni₀.₁合金薄膜在蓝宝石和硅酸镓镧基底上（含10nm Zr粘附层）的热演化行为。通过真空退火至800°C，发现薄膜在400-600°C区间发生锐利的粗化转变，最终在800°C形成融合的小面状晶粒。基底依赖性明显：蓝宝石产生更大的晶粒，而硅酸镓镧在600°C时展现更大的粗糙度峰值。
AI.motivation: 理解PtNi合金薄膜在高温下的热稳定性及其基底依赖性，这对于高温声表面波器件等应用至关重要。通过定量表征薄膜形态演化的动力学机制，为器件设计提供材料稳定性依据。
AI.method: 采用序贯真空退火（室温至800°C），结合原子力显微镜、图像分割、高度分布分析和有效粗化指标（有效Arrhenius分析基于Δ⟨r²⟩）等多种定量表征手段，系统追踪薄膜在不同温度下的形态演化路径。
AI.result: 两类薄膜在400°C以下保持致密颗粒状，400-600°C发生锐利粗化转变，800°C形成融合小面晶粒。蓝宝石上平均投影面积从3.32×10²增长到1.67×10⁵ nm²（更大晶粒），硅酸镓镧上从7.84×10²增长到1.09×10⁵ nm²。两种基底均在600°C出现粗糙度峰值，随后在800°C部分平滑化。
AI.conclusion: PtNi/Zr薄膜在蓝宝石和硅酸镓镧上的热稳定性由合金迁移率、界面能量学和基底依赖的形态选择三者的耦合作用共同决定。400-600°C是主导粗化窗口，该转变并非均匀平移初始颗粒分布，而是用新的大特征集合替代原有颗粒群体。

title: AES-Debye: an Accurate, Efficient, and Scalable Engine for Debye Scattering Calculations
summary: Total scattering models are essential for characterizing the structure and disorder of nanoscale materials. The Debye scattering equation (DSE) provides a rigorous route to elastic total scattering, but its direct evaluation is computationally demanding because pairwise contributions must be accumulated at every scattering vector, whereas common acceleration strategies based on binned pair-distance distributions or gridded fast Fourier transforms can introduce discretization and aliasing artifacts that compromise diffuse-scattering accuracy. Here, we present AES-Debye, an accuracy-preserving DSE framework that aggregates pair distances into a pair distribution function (PDF) using corrected bin centers and numerically robust accumulation to suppress discretization and summation errors. A data-locality-aware parallel design enables efficient execution on CPUs and GPUs. We demonstrate strong scalability by computing a high-resolution total scattering profile for a system of 90 million atoms, $(0.1,μ\mathrm{m})^{3}$, in minutes on a distributed-memory CPU platform. These capabilities extend accurate elastic total scattering calculations to large, complex systems while simultaneously providing high-resolution PDFs for downstream structural analysis.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了AES-Debye框架，一种保持精度的Debye散射方程（DSE）求解方法。它通过使用修正的bin中心和数值稳健的累积方法将原子对距离聚合为PDF，抑制离散化和求和误差，并采用数据局部性感知的并行设计在CPU和GPU上高效执行。在分布式内存CPU平台上，仅用几分钟即可计算9000万原子（0.1μm）³系统的高分辨率总散射图谱。
AI.motivation: Debye散射方程的直接求值计算成本极高，因为需要在每个散射向量处累积所有原子对贡献；而基于分箱对距离分布或网格化快速傅里叶变换的常见加速策略会引入离散化和混叠伪影，损害漫散射精度。因此需要一种既高效又保持精度的DSE求解方法。
AI.method: AES-Debye框架采用三个关键设计：(1) 使用修正的bin中心和数值稳健的积累方法将原子对距离聚合为PDF，抑制离散化和求和误差；(2) 数据局部性感知的并行设计，实现CPU和GPU上的高效执行；(3) 支持分布式内存平台，实现大规模并行计算。
AI.result: 在分布式内存CPU平台上，仅用几分钟就完成了9000万原子、(0.1μm)³系统的高分辨率总散射图谱计算，展现出强可扩展性。
AI.conclusion: AES-Debye将精确的弹性总散射计算扩展到大而复杂的系统，同时为下游结构分析提供高分辨率PDF，弥合了DSE精确性与实际大规模计算需求之间的鸿沟。
